65798.title: Coyote vs. Acme
65798.synopsis: After enduring years of catastrophic product failures at the hands of ACME, Inc., a tenacious, unemployed coyote uncovers a corporate cover-up and spearheads an unhinged battle against the multinational conglomerate that's been blowing him up in the name of profit. Also, there's a roadrunner. And dynamite.
65798.cast: John Cena, Lana Condor, Will Forte

70533.title: Avengers: Doomsday
70533.synopsis: Universes collide and the Multiverse Saga begins its final chapter in Marvel Studios' Avengers: Doomsday. Beloved heroes from three distinct universes will be set on a deadly collision course and ultimately face an existential threat unlike anything they've ever encountered. This epic film will lay the foundation for the future of the Marvel Cinematic Universe.

71470.title: Forgotten Island
71470.synopsis: Your best friendship is worth fighting for.
71470.advisory: AMC has been advised that this film contains sequences with flashing lights that may affect photosensitive viewers.

72478.title: Disney's Hexed
72478.synopsis: In Hexed, an impulsive and unconventional teenage girl named Billie (voice of Hailee Steinfeld) discovers secret magical abilities which, once unleashed, hurtle her into a spectacle-filled journey out of suburbia and into a vast witch realm called Hexe. Forced to team up with her cautious mother, Alice (voice of Rashida Jones), they uncover family mysteries that could change the world of witches forever. Directed by Fawn Veerasunthorn and Jason Hand, co-directed by Josie Trinidad, and produced by Roy Conli and Yvett Merino.
72478.directors: Fawn Veerasunthorn, Jason Hand, Josie Trinidad

76238.title: The Odyssey
76238.synopsis:
Christopher Nolan's next film, THE ODYSSEY, is a mythic action epic shot across the world using brand new IMAX film technology. The film brings Homer's foundational saga to IMAX film screens for the first time and opens in theaters everywhere on July 17, 2026.

The Odyssey stars Matt Damon, Tom Holland, Anne Hathaway, Robert Pattinson and Lupita Nyong'o, with Zendaya and Charlize Theron.

The Odyssey is produced by Emma Thomas and Christopher Nolan for their company, Syncopy. The executive producer is Thomas Hayslip.
76238.advisory: AMC has been advised that this film contains sequences with flashing lights that may affect photosensitive viewers.
76238.cast: Anne Hathaway, Matt Damon, Tom Holland

76536.title: The Cat in the Hat
76536.synopsis: Meet the Cat in the Hat you don't know! In the wonderfully whimsical tradition of Dr. Seuss, THE CAT IN THE HAT, voiced by Bill Hader, comes to the big screen in his animated theatrical feature film debut, an all-new, epic adventure where mischief, magic and mayhem reign supreme.
76536.cast: Bill Hader, Paula Pell, Quinta Brunson, Xochitl Gomez

77032.title: Dune: Part Three
77032.synopsis:
From Warner Bros. Pictures and Legendary Pictures comes Dune: Part Three, bringing Academy Award-nominated filmmaker Denis Villeneuve’s epic trilogy to a breathtaking conclusion. 

Dune: Part Three is set nearly two decades after Paul Atreides seized control of the Imperium. Now a ruthless Emperor, Paul must face the consequences of his reign as old allies return, terrifying new threats emerge, and betrayal lurks in every shadow. Haunted by visions of Imperial collapse and the reappearance of his long-lost love, Paul is drawn into a sweeping conspiracy, with Chani at the heart of its unfolding mystery. As rebellion brews and enemies close in, Paul must confront the true cost of power and the fate of those he loves the most.

77101.title: Insidious: Out of the Further
77101.synopsis:
Having earned over $740 million at the global box office, the Insidious franchise returns with a new family and a terror that redefines what The Further is capable of.

In INSIDIOUS: OUT OF THE FURTHER, Amelia Eve stars as Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in who discovers she can travel into The Further, the purgatorial realm of lost souls at the heart of the Insidious universe. When something evil comes after her, Gemma discovers an ability that changes everything: she doesn't just enter The Further, she can bring what lives there back to the real world. Once the demons realize her power, our world becomes their playground.

With Lin Shaye reprising her iconic role as Elise Rainier and Jacob Chase (Come Play) directing, INSIDIOUS: OUT OF THE FURTHER opens August 21, 2026. Screenplay by Jacob Chase. Story by David Leslie Johnson-McGoldrick and Jacob Chase.

77249.title: Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
77249.synopsis: THE HUNGER GAMES: SUNRISE ON THE REAPING will revisit the world of Panem 24 years before the events of The Hunger Games, starting on the morning of the reaping of the 50th Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.
77249.cast: Jesse Plemons, Joseph Zada, Ralph Fiennes

77282.title: Violent Night 2
77282.synopsis:
If you're nice, you get presents from the Big Guy. If you're naughty, you get justice.

David Harbour reprises his role as Santa Claus in a propulsive new chapter in yuletide mayhem from 87North--the powerhouse producers of Bullet Train, John Wick, The Fall Guy, Atomic Blonde and the Nobody franchise--and returning action director Tommy Wirkola.

In 2022's bare-knuckle holiday sensation, VIOLENT NIGHT, an embittered Santa, armed with lethal combat skills, took out a team of mercenaries to rescue a girl and her family. Now, not-so-jolly Saint Nick suits up again to take on a ruthless gangster (Emmy and Golden Globe nominee Jared Harris) terrorizing the merchants of the Silver Bell Mall.

But when Santa forgets the true meaning of Christmas, he finds himself in the heart of a lively mall community in desperate need of his help. Sapped of his magic, he'll need another way to take on the goons threatening the mall, and time is running out. Santa has to rediscover his faith in goodness and call in some last-minute reinforcements from the one person no baddie wants to tangle with: Mrs. Claus (Emmy and Golden Globe nominee Kristen Bell). 

Along with David Harbour, Jared Harris and Kristen Bell, the dynamic cast includes Emmy winning screen legend Joe Pantoliano (The Last of Us, The Sopranos), Daniela Melchior (Fast X, Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3), Andrew Bachelor (Greenland, The Walking Dead), and AEW professional wrestler Maxwell Friedman (The Iron Claw, Happy Gilmore 2).

VIOLENT NIGHT 2 is directed by returning filmmaker Tommy Wirkola and produced again by 87North founders Kelly McCormick and David Leitch. The film's returning screenwriters are Pat Casey and Josh Miller. Violent Night 2 will be released by Universal Pictures.
77282.cast: David Harbour, Jared Harris, Kristen Bell

77331.title: Practical Magic 2
77331.synopsis: PRACTICAL MAGIC 2 returns to a world steeped in moonlit mischief and powerful ancestral magic, as the Owens sisters must confront the dark curse that threatens to unravel their family once and for all in a must-see cinematic event of fun, magic and mayhem.
77331.cast: Joey King, Nicole Kidman, Sandra Bullock

77447.title: Street Fighter
77447.synopsis: Set in 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu and Ken Masters are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don't, it's GAME OVER!
77447.cast: Andrew Koji, Callina Liang, Noah Centineo

78598.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
78598.synopsis:
It's a BRAND NEW DAY for Peter Parker. Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn’t remember him -- and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him -- sparks a change in Peter he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a  powerful villain no one can even see.
The world may have forgotten Peter Parker, but he hasn’t forgotten them.

78614.title: Jumanji: Open World
78614.cast: Dwayne Johnson, Jack Black, Kevin Hart

79125.title: Digger
79125.synopsis: The most powerful man in the world embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity's savior before the disaster he's unleashed destroys everything.

79305.title: Werwulf
79305.synopsis: Witness Robert Eggers’ most visceral and haunting experience yet. Focus Features presents WERWULF, a harrowing tale of devotion, damnation and the devil within.

79564.title: Focker-In-Law
79564.synopsis: A young man named Henry, son of Greg and Pam Focker, faces family chaos when he decides to marry a strong-willed woman who appears to be his complete mismatch.
79564.cast: Ben Stiller, Robert De Niro, Teri Polo

79697.title: Resident Evil
79697.synopsis: In an all-new story, Resident Evil follows Bryan (Austin Abrams), a medical courier who unwittingly finds himself in an action-packed, non-stop race for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.
79697.advisory: AMC has been advised that this film contains sequences with flashing lights that may affect photosensitive viewers.

79853.title: Verity
79853.synopsis: Struggling writer Lowen Ashleigh is hired as a ghostwriter for renowned author Verity Crawford under mysterious circumstances, but her assignment takes a dark turn after discovering chilling autobiographical notes. Faced with a series of deadly family secrets, Lowen struggles to separate fiction from reality, while also blurring the lines with Verity's husband, Jeremy.
79853.cast: Anne Hathaway, Dakota Johnson, Josh Hartnett

79935.title: ZERO A.D.: The Birth of Christ
79935.synopsis: A brutal ruler fears a prophecy and orders the death of a child - one who will change history.
79935.cast: Ben Mendelsohn, Deva Cassel, Gael Garcia Bernal, Sam Worthington

80290.title: How to Rob a Bank
80290.synopsis: In HOW TO ROB A BANK, a crew of social media-savvy bank robbers broadcasts their daring heists, unaware that their growing viral fame has put them in the crosshairs of a veteran FBI agent and a brilliant software engineer. Despite the unlikely duo closing in, the crime ring pushes past their limits, putting everything on the line for their most ambitious heist yet.
80290.cast: Anna Sawai, Nicholas Hoult, Pete Davidson

80303.title: Other Mommy
80303.synopsis:
Can I go inside your heart? 

From James Wan, one of the most influential architects of modern horror and the visionary behind M3GAN, Saw, Insidious and The Conjuring franchises--comes a terrifying, supernatural trip into the darkening world of a young girl as her family, and their home, are haunted by a sinister entity that is determined to take up residence inside her. But first, it needs to persuade her to let it in ... Academy Award winner Jessica Chastain (It Chapter Two, The Eyes of Tammy Faye), Jay Duplass (Transparent, Industry), Arabella Olivia Clark (Springsteen: Deliver Me From Nowhere, The Hand that Rocks the Cradle) and Dichen Lachman (Severance) star in this chilling tale of terror, from Rob Savage, the bold genre director of the acclaimed films Host and The Boogeyman. From Atomic Monster and Blumhouse, the film is from a screenplay by WGA award winner Nathan Elston, writer for the Emmy-winning sensation Succession, based on the New York Times bestselling novel Incidents Around the House by Josh Malerman (Bird Box). The film is produced by James Wan and is executive produced by Michael Clear, Judson Scott, Macdara Kelleher, Rob Savage, Josh Malerman and Ryan Lewis. Alayna Glasthal is the executive overseeing the film for Atomic Monster.
80303.advisory: AMC has been advised that this film contains sequences with flashing lights that may affect photosensitive viewers.

80471.title: Whalefall
80471.synopsis: Following the death of his father (Josh Brolin), Jay Gardiner (Austin Abrams) goes diving off the central Coast of California in search of his remains, but is swallowed by a massive sperm whale. While trapped inside its belly with only one hour of oxygen left, Jay comes to realize that the hard-earned lessons his father imparted may be the key to his escape.

80621.title: Ali G: Who Iz I?
80621.synopsis: After twenty years spent “chillin’, tokin’ and bonin’”, Ali G is shocked to discover that his long-term girlfriend, Julie, is 8 months pregnant. Faced with an extra mouth to feed, he gets off his batty and heads to America to reclaim his former glory… but soon encounters adversaries who will ultimately threaten his and his child’s very existence. Sacha Baron Cohen’s new film, ALI G: WHO IZ I? marks his directorial debut and will be released in theaters on October 23.

80751.title: California Schemin'
80751.synopsis: Based on a 'true lie', CALIFORNIA SCHEMIN' tells the true story of Gavin Bain and Billy Boyd, two Scottish rappers from Dundee who, after being ridiculed for their accents, reinvented themselves as American hip-hop artists from California to succeed in the music industry.
80751.cast: James McAvoy, Samuel Bottomley, Seamus McLean Ross

80758.title: DreamQuil
80758.synopsis: Set in the near future, Carol (Elizabeth Banks) joins DreamQuil, an avant-garde digital wellness retreat, to save her marriage to Gary (John C. Reilly). While she's away, a robotic clone known as "Carol 2" takes her place at home. But when Carol returns, she finds herself caught in a mysterious and sinister nightmare.

81643.title: The Social Reckoning
81643.synopsis: Inspired by true events and the whistleblower who started the social media reckoning we?re seeing play out today, this Aaron Sorkin original screenplay is a companion piece to the hit film The Social Network and a true David and Goliath story. Frances Haugen (Madison), a young Facebook engineer, enlists the help of Jeff Horwitz (White), a Wall Street Journal reporter, to go on a dangerous journey that ends up blowing the whistle on the social network?s most guarded secrets.

81847.title: Ghost Soldier
81847.synopsis: In the action-thriller GHOST SOLDIER, Jim Caviezel stars as Henry "Fitz" Fitzgerald, a solitary man with a mysterious past, living a quiet life off the grid in his hometown. But when a powerful foreign corporation descends on his community determined to seize his and his neighbors' land for a massive payday, Fitz takes action -- he's actually a former Special Forces soldier and advanced weapons developer. Armed with weapons no one has ever seen, a lifetime of lethal military training, and an unwavering code of justice, Fitz becomes the one thing his enemies never anticipated: a one-man war they can't win.
81847.cast: Beau Knapp, Jim Caviezel, Olivia Thirlby

81938.title: Ebenezer
81938.synopsis: This November, Johnny Depp is Ebenezer Scrooge. The name you know, the story you don?t. From Ti West, EBENEZER also stars Rupert Grint, Andrea Riseborough, Sam Claflin, Daisy Ridley, Arthur Conti, Ellie Bamber, Henry Lloyd-Hughes, Charlie Murphy, with Tramell Tillman and Ian McKellen.

82178.title: Sense and Sensibility
82178.synopsis: From Focus Features and Working Title comes an irresistible new take on Jane Austen?s iconic Sense and Sensibility: a charming, witty, and deeply relatable story of love and sisterhood starring Daisy Edgar-Jones and Esme Creed-Miles.

82342.title: Avengers Endgame: Encore
82342.synopsis: The epic conclusion to the Infinity Saga returns to theaters as Avengers Endgame:Encore on September 25, 2026. After devastating events wiped out half the world’s population, the remaining heroes struggle to move forward. Ultimately, they must come together to restore order and harmony in the universe and bring their loved ones back in a dramatic showdown against Thanos.
82342.advisory: AMC has been advised that this film contains sequences with flashing lights that may affect photosensitive viewers.
82342.cast: Chris Evans, Chris Hemsworth, Mark Ruffalo, Robert Downey Jr., Scarlett Johansson

82510.title: Pendulum
82510.synopsis: Married couple Patrick (Gordon-Levitt) and Abigail (Dynevor) travel to a secluded New Mexico retreat seeking healing after a traumatic event. But as Abigail falls deeper under the influence of the retreat's enigmatic leader (Weaver), Patrick begins to suspect something far more sinister lurks beneath the group's spiritual promises. As paranoia spirals into terror, the couple uncovers a horrifying truth that may consume them both before they can escape.
82510.cast: Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Norman Reedus, Phoebe Dynevor

82629.title: Wildwood
82629.synopsis: It follows a girl?s desperate quest to save her baby brother, which becomes a high-stakes journey into a forbidden forest filled with enchanted creatures, unlikely allies and formidable adversaries, where an entire hidden realm hangs in the balance.
82629.cast: Carey Mulligan, Jacob Tremblay, Peyton Elizabeth Lee

82707.title: Heart of the Beast
82707.synopsis: After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces officer James Belmont (Brad Pitt) and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements. From acclaimed filmmaker David Ayer, HEART OF THE BEAST is an intense adventure thriller that explores the unbreakable bond between a man and his best friend as they face their greatest battle yet.
82707.cast: Anna Lambe, Brad Pitt, J.K. Simmons

82739.title: I Play Rocky
82739.synopsis: The film is an electrifying true story about an unknown actor with an unshakable belief that he wasn't just meant to write Rocky--he was meant to be Rocky Balboa. Told "no" at every turn, Sylvester Stallone bets everything on himself, holding the line on playing the lead against seemingly impossible odds. The result is the ultimate underdog story behind the ultimate underdog movie.
82739.cast: Annasophia Robb, Anthony Ippolito, Matt Dillon

82776.title: Gone with the Wind (2026 Event)
82776.synopsis:
Clark Gable, Vivien Leigh, Olivia de Havilland and Hattie McDaniel star in this classic epic of the American South.

On the eve of the United States Civil War, rich, beautiful and self-centered Scarlett O"Hara (Leigh) has everything she could want -- except Ashley Wilkes (Leslie Howard). But as the war devastates the South, Scarlett discovers the strength within herself to protect her family and rebuild her life. Through everything, she longs for Ashley, unaware that she is already married to the man she really loves (Gable)?and who truly loves her -- until she finally drives him away. Only then does Scarlett realize what she has lost - and decide to win him back.

Considered one of the greatest classic American movies, Gone With The Wind won 10 Academy Awards, including Best Picture, Best Actress and Best Supporting Actress, Hattie McDaniel, the first Oscar awarded to an African-American actor.

This special release includes exclusive insight from Leonard Maltin.

82779.title: The Maltese Falcon 85th Anniversary
82779.synopsis: Academy Award winner Humphrey Bogart stars in this classic film noir as tough San Francisco private detective Sam Spade in the classic, convoluted story of Spade?s involvement with a deadly band of international thieves who will lie, double cross and murder to obtain a small, jewel-encrusted statue known as The Maltese Falcon.
82779.cast: Gladys George, Humphrey Bogart, Mary Astor

82780.title: A Beautiful Mind 25th Anniversary
82780.synopsis:
A mathematical genius, John Forbes Nash, Jr. made an astonishing discovery early in life and stood on the brink of international acclaim. But his prodigious career was sidetracked by problems that would have broken many men. Nash, however, fought back. He had always been driven by his quest for one truly original idea and never lost sight of that dream. After many years of struggle, he triumphed over tragedy and literally changed the world. The film is inspired by events in the life of John Forbes Nash, Jr., and in part based on the biography A Beautiful Mind, by Sylvia Nasar.

This special 25th anniversary release includes exclusive insight from Leonard Maltin.
82780.cast: Ed Harris, Jennifer Connelly, Russell Crowe

82788.title: It's a Wonderful Life 80th Anniversary
82788.synopsis: Embraced as a cherished holiday tradition by families around the world, Frank Capra?s heart-warming masterpiece now celebrates 75 years with this big-screen event. George Bailey (James Stewart) sets aside his dreams of world travel to run his father?s small community bank, and protect the people of Bedford Falls from greedy businessman Mr. Potter (Lionel Barrymore). When a costly mistake pushes George to the brink of despair, a visit from a kindly angel (Henry Travers) will show George how the life of one good man can change the world forever.
82788.cast: Donna Reed, James Stewart, Lionel Barrymore

82856.title: Rolling Loud: The Movie
82856.synopsis: A father makes a bad parenting choice by taking his young son to a wild hip-hop festival, leading to chaos as they navigate crowds, security, and family dynamics with eccentric companions.
82856.cast: Christine Ko, Matt Rife, Owen Wilson

82875.title: Mr. Irrelevant
82875.synopsis: The movie will tell the inspiring, heart-felt, and true story of John Tuggle, the "Mr. Irrelevant" of the 1983 draft, the last player chosen in the last round, by the New York Giants, and his enduring impact on his team and teammates.

82937.title: Wild Horse Nine
82937.synopsis: In 1973 Chile, CIA agents Chris and Lee face a trust-testing journey from Santiago to Easter Island.

83023.title: JIMMY
83023.synopsis: JIMMY, the untold true story of America's most-beloved actor and the iconic role that saved him, focuses on the most transformative season in Jimmy Stewart's life--from winning the Academy Award for Best Actor in The Philadelphia Story to enlisting and becoming a combat pilot in the U.S. Army Air Corps at the beginning of World War II. Stewart flew twenty missions over Europe, rising to the rank of colonel by the end of the war, only to return home broken and disheartened. Then George Bailey and It's a Wonderful Life came calling...
83023.cast: K.J. Apa, Kara Killmer, Max Casella

83096.title: Victorian Psycho
83096.synopsis: Set in Victorian England, Victorian Psycho sees an eccentric governess arrive at a remote gothic manor, where strange happenings stir suspicion that she?s not what she seems.
83096.cast: Jason Isaacs, Maika Monroe, Thomasin McKenzie

83284.title: Dossier 137 / Case 137
83284.synopsis: Following the Yellow Vest protests of Paris in 2018, internal affairs officer Stephanie Bertrand (played by Lea Drucker) must investigate the conduct of her fellow police officers during the demonstrations. Though striving to remain objective, Stephanie?s position leaves her at stark odds with the rest of the police force. When she scrutinizes the near-fatal assault of a teenage protester from her hometown, Stephanie is met with growing institutional pressure to drop the case and move on. The further her investigation develops, the more Stephanie?s faith in the system she belongs to is tested.

83382.title: The Angry Birds Movie: 10th Anniversary
83382.synopsis: Celebrate the 10th anniversary of The Angry Birds Movie with a limited three-night theatrical event this November. A proven family hit filled with action, humor, and fan-favorite characters, this special engagement brings audiences back to Bird Island for a big-screen experience the whole family will enjoy.
83382.cast: Bill Hader, Danny McBride, Jason Sudeikis, Josh Gad

83493.title: Guillermo del Toro's Pan's Labyrinth 20th Anniversary
83493.synopsis: Celebrating its 20th Anniversary, PAN'S LABYRINTH, from visionary filmmaker Guillermo del Toro, is an Academy Award?--winning dark fantasy set in 1944 Spain. As fascist forces tighten their grip following the Spanish Civil War, young Ofelia (Ivana Baquero) is uprooted to a remote military outpost commanded by her cruel stepfather (Sergi Lopez). Amid the brutality of war, Ofelia discovers a hidden labyrinth and encounters a mysterious faun who claims she is a lost princess. To reclaim her throne, she must complete three dangerous tasks that test her courage and spirit. As reality and fantasy intertwine, Ofelia's journey becomes a powerful exploration of innocence, resistance, and the enduring power of imagination in the face of unimaginable darkness.
83493.cast: Ariadna Gil, Ivana Baquero, Maribel Verdu

83499.title: Ninja Scroll
83499.synopsis:
Shown in 4K where available

When Jubei saves a young ninja woman from the unthinkable, he assumes that's the end of it. To his surprise, it's only just the beginning. Together, the two investigate the mysterious deaths of an entire village which uncovers a conspiracy of demonic proportions! Getting closer to the truth, the demonic forces will stop at nothing to silence Jubei and his companion for good!
83499.cast: Emi Shinohara, Koichi Yamadera, Takeshi Aono

83591.title: Spirited Away 25th Anniversary - Studio Ghibli Fest 2026
83591.synopsis: Winner of the Academy Award for Best Animated Feature, Hayao Miyazaki's wondrous fantasy adventure is a dazzling masterpiece from one of the most celebrated filmmakers in the history of animation. Chihiro's family is moving to a new house, but when they stop on the way to explore an abandoned village, her parents undergo a mysterious transformation and Chihiro is whisked into a world of fantastic spirits ruled over by the sorceress Yubaba. Put to work in a magical bathhouse for spirits and demons, Chihiro must use all her wits to survive in this strange new place, find a way to free her parents and return to the normal world. Overflowing with imaginative creatures and thrilling storytelling, Spirited Away became a worldwide smash hit, and is one of the most critically-acclaimed films of all time.
83591.cast: Daveigh Chase, Jason Marsden, Susan Egan

83683.title: November 1963
83683.synopsis: The story of the Killing of a President as told by Joseph Giancana, who was with his brother, Sam Giancana during those days. Written by their nephew and told in real time about the underbelly that pulled off this crime.
83683.cast: Dermot Mulroney, John Travolta, Robert Carlyle

83713.title: Flywheel: Ignition of the Soul
83713.synopsis:
The film that launched the Kendrick Brothers into becoming some of the leading faith-based filmmakers in the world for the last two decades, Flywheel, has been reimagined by Brazilian filmmakers under the Kendricks' direct guidance. The project emerged out of the Kendrick Brothers' growing impact in Brazil. Their 2024 film, The Forge, opened in the Brazilian market at #1 and greatly exceeded box-office expectations. While promoting The Forge release, Alex and Stephen Kendrick connected with leaders across the country who expressed a growing need for locally rooted, faith-driven content.  From those conversations, a Brazilian FLYWHEEL remake was born. 

Set in Rio de Janeiro, the new film FLYWHEEL: IGNITION OF THE SOUL follows Noah Silva, a smooth-talking, used-car salesman whose "do whatever it takes" approach to business and life begins to unravel at home and at work.  After a series of wake-up calls, Noah is forced to confront the cost of his choices. He begins a difficult and deeply personal journey to restore his integrity while trying to win back the hearts of his wife and son.
83713.cast: Guilherme Tavares, Mario Bregieira, Perola Faria

83714.title: Angel and the Badman
83714.synopsis: When feared outlaw Quirt Evans staggers onto a rancher's land with a bullet in his back, he expects a quick death, not mercy. But Penny, the rancher's daughter, offers him a chance at something he's never had: a life beyond violence. However, the past doesn't forgive. With the marshal closing in and an outlaw gang ready to burn the ranch to the ground, Quirt must decide what kind of man he'll be when the world demands blood.

83723.title: Drummer Boy
83723.synopsis: Drummer Boy is an action-musical from four-time Grammy-winning music group For King and Country, which follows two brothers as they find themselves on opposite sides of the American Revolutionary War.

83726.title: Hershey
83726.synopsis:
Based on the life of Milton Hershey, founder of the iconic Hershey chocolate company. 

Milton's grit and determination to conquer the world of candy-making propel him from bankruptcy to monumental success, and the love of his life, Kitty, helps him build a legacy sweeter than any candy bar. But when Kitty falls ill, Milton's wild optimism teeters on the edge of destruction, and she sparks an even bolder dream: to leave their fortune in the hands of America's orphans.

83930.title: MET Opera: Samson et Dalila (2026)
83930.synopsis: Sacred, scandalous, and irresistibly alluring, Saint-Saens's spectacular take on the biblical hero of legendary strength and the seductive Philistine whose beauty overpowers him returns in the Met's larger-than-life production. Featuring a massive orchestra and chorus and some of opera's most spellbinding tunes, this masterpiece of French grand opera is a feast for the eyes and ears. Giacomo Sagripanti conducts an electrifying cast led by the formidable star pairing of mezzo-soprano Aigul Akhmetshina and tenor Clay Hilley, transmitted live to cinemas worldwide.
83930.cast: Aigul Akhmetshina, Clay Hilley, Quinn Kelse

83952.title: Above the Below
83952.synopsis: In this tense thriller, three astronauts (Idris Elba, Caitlin FitzGerald, and Hero Fiennes Tiffin) return to Earth only to discover their fight for survival has just begun. Directed by Idris Elba and Martin Owen, the film follows the crew after their damaged spacecraft is violently hurled through the atmosphere and plunges into the depths of the ocean. With oxygen rapidly running out and hope fading, they are forced to make an unthinkable choice: who will risk everything to reach the surface...and who will remain behind with the wreckage below.

83961.title: Carl Jackson's LAX: Holiday in New York
83961.synopsis: The third and final installment of the trilogy is LAX: Holiday in New York, directed by Carl Jackson. Set against the glittering, holiday-lit backdrop of New York City, the film centers on John and Kelly. The couple is in the middle of a divorce but decides to come together to spend one final Christmas holiday as a family. However, old secrets quickly resurface and hidden tensions ignite, making them realize that reuniting for the holidays may have been their most dangerous mistake yet.

84071.title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
84071.synopsis: From writer-director Bassam Tariq, Your Mother, Your Mother, Your Mother stars Mahershala Ali as Latif, a devoutly religious hitman who struggles to balance work, faith and fatherhood. When his wife dies, he embarks on a desperate journey across Houston to protect his children, confronting the forces closing in around him - and the beliefs threatening to unravel within.

84113.title: The Mongoose
84113.synopsis: Accused of a crime he didn't commit and with nothing to lose, a war hero (Liam Neeson) leads law enforcement on a cross-country car chase with the help of his brothers in arms and a sympathetic public rooting for his getaway.
84113.cast: Liam Neeson, Marisa Tomei, Ving Rhames

84118.title: Flavia Girl Detective
84118.synopsis: Amateur detective. Master poisoner. Eleven years old. When Flavia finds a dead body at her family's decaying British manor house and her father is accused of murder, she dives into her own wild and fearless investigation, unearthing long-held family secrets and pitting herself against the true murderer. A little genius goes a long way. Based on the internationally renowned and New York Times bestselling The Flavia de Luce mystery book series.
84118.cast: Jonathan Pryce, Martin Freeman, Molly Belle Wright

84131.title: Christmas at the Kringles
84131.synopsis: The Severson family move to a suburban neighborhood where their neighbors, the Kringles, celebrate Christmas year-round and harbor sinister intentions to hypnotize and indoctrinate them.

84140.title: The Last Blossom
84140.synopsis:
Former yakuza Akutsu is serving life in prison after a middling career in the underworld. On the night he lays dying in his cell, he reminisces with his only companion, a smart-mouthed flower growing out of a can, about the choices that brought him here, the woman he loved, and a child he would give everything to protect. Is redemption out of reach?

From director Baku Kinoshita and writer Kazuya Konomoto, creators of ODDTAXI, and award-winning Studio CLAP (Pompo the Cinephile), THE LAST BLOSSOM is a thrillingly original work from animation's most inventive new talent. Moving across time and memory, the film is an unforgettable meditation on found family, sacrifice, and the complicated pieces that join together to make a life.
84140.cast: Hikari Mitsushima, Junki Tozuka, Kaoru Kobayashi

84142.title: Once Upon a Time in Harlem
84142.synopsis: A decade post-death, filmmaker William Greaves reveals his final work: footage of a 1972 gathering he arranged with Harlem Renaissance legends, which he deemed his most significant capture.
84142.directors: David Greaves, Liani Greaves, William Greaves

84182.title: Beware Boiuna
84182.synopsis: Deep in the Amazon, a medical mission spirals into a fight for survival when Boiuna, a colossal ancient predator, awakens to reclaim her domain. In the jungle where nature holds absolute power, she decides who lives and who dies.

84191.title: Misty Green
84191.synopsis: Years after her Hollywood breakthrough, a talented actress whose career has stalled fights for her second act.
84191.cast: Adam Driver, Anna Kendrick, Topher Grace

84204.title: The FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH
84204.synopsis: Murder, blackmail, theft, extortion — just another summer in Hollywood. It’s 1977, eight years since Cliff Booth (Brad Pitt) encountered the Manson family in Quentin Tarantino’s parallel history of 1969, Once Upon a Time… in Hollywood. In THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH, directed by David Fincher from a new script by Tarantino, the fairytale is over. Los Angeles no longer needs a hippie-slaying stuntman the way it did. But Hollywood will always have problems, problems that can only be solved by someone with Cliff’s unique (occasionally extralegal) abilities. When he’s not earning his keep bartending or as a projectionist, Cliff Booth is a fixer — solving situations for Hollywood’s great and, sometimes, not so good. He’s curious when he gets a call from talent agent Karen Crosby (Elizabeth Debicki), on behalf of her client, TV megastar Charlie Peters (Scott Caan) — a man known for doing his own stunts. And he’s further entertained and intrigued when he meets other characters in Charlie’s world, from his knowing wife Toni (Carla Gugino) to pro football champion turned screen star Roderick “Hot Rod” Harrison (Yahya Abdul-Mateen II). Then there are the Verdusco brothers (Matt Groove and JB Tadena), mysterious gangsters causing mayhem across the city. What was once a fairytale is now a crime story — a cocktail of violence, ambition, and desire that could only happen in LA. Discover whether the further adventures — or mis-adventures — of Cliff Booth end happily ever after on November 25 in IMAX at AMC.
84204.cast: Brad Pitt, Elizabeth Debicki, Scott Caan

84276.title: MET Opera: Macbeth (2026)
84276.synopsis: Verdi's gripping music drama, based on Shakespeare's tragedy about a ruthless married couple, tells the story of Macbeth, tormented by guilt, and his ambitious wife, whose relentless lust for power leads them both to ruin. The outstanding dramatic soprano Lise Davidsen provides vocal highlights in her highly anticipated role debut as Lady Macbeth.

84284.title: MET Opera: Carmen (2026 Encore)
84284.synopsis: Bizet?s masterpiece of the seductress who lives by her own rules has had an impact far beyond the opera house. The opera?s melodic sweep is as irresistible as the title character herself, a force of nature who has become a defining female cultural figure. Carmen was a scandal at its premiere but soon after became a triumphal success and has remained one of the most frequently staged operas in the world.

84291.title: MET Opera: Magic Flute Holiday Encore (2026)
84291.synopsis: The Met made history in December 2006 when it presented its first Live in HD transmission to movie theaters worldwide ?the abridged English-language version of Mozart?s The Magic Flute. This holiday season, the opera returns to select movie theaters in a special encore presentation.

84296.title: MET Opera: Cosi Fan Tutte Encore (2026)
84296.synopsis: Imbued with captivating melodies and subtle wit, Mozart's comedy about the fickleness of young love ranks among his most sublime creations. Phelim McDermott's colorful, imaginative production relocates the turbulent action to a 1950s amusement park, where the lovers embark on an emotional and exhilarating rollercoaster ride.

84298.title: MET Opera: Samson et Dalila Encore (2026)

84308.title: Paper Tiger
84308.synopsis: Two brothers pursue the American Dream but get entangled in a dangerous Russian mafia scheme that terrorizes their family, testing their bond as betrayal becomes possible.

84326.title: Sight & Sound Presents: Joshua Live!
84326.synopsis: Journey alongside the people of Israel as they navigate their newfound freedom in an unforgiving wilderness and under a new leader, Joshua.  Captured in front of a live audience, JOSHUA LIVE! combines the energy of stage performance with the immersive experience of the cinema, bringing this unforgettable story of faith, courage and redemption to movie theaters.

84334.title: ENE Repeat
84334.synopsis: ENE REPEAT reunites a close-knit group of friends as they embark on another unforgettable journey, where old memories, new adventures, and unexpected twists test their friendship.
84334.cast: Abhinav Gomatam, Maganti Srinath, Vishwak Sen

84340.title: Udta Teer
84340.cast: Ayushmann Khurrana, Salim Siddiqui, Sara Ali Khan

84343.title: Appofeniacs
84343.synopsis: As AI-generated deepfakes spread, a group of interconnected lives spiral into paranoia, blurring reality and unleashing violent consequences, revealing that true horror lies not in the deceit, but in what happens when people believe it.

84351.title: Coward
84351.synopsis: Pierre, a young Belgian soldier, wants to prove himself on the battlefield during the First World War. Behind the front lines, he meets Francis, who is asked to find a way to boost morale.

84355.title: Minotaur
84355.synopsis: Intrigue, corruption, betrayal, survival: the walls of the maze are closing in. The latest from Academy Award nominated writer-director Andrey Zvyagintsev (Loveless, Leviathan), Cannes Grand Prix winner MINOTAUR is a twist-laden parable for our times. Russia, 2022. Amidst the comfortable trappings of affluence and domesticity, corporate executive Gleb (Dmitriy Mazurov) finds himself under siege on all fronts. At home, he is haunted by suspicions that his increasingly distant wife Galina (Iris Lebedeva) is unfaithful. At work, he contends with a demand from local authorities to draft a quota of employees for the war in Ukraine. Desperate to keep his hands clean, Gleb struggles to reassert control even as the collapse of his carefully ordered life seems fated to accelerate toward violence. A pressure cooker in cinematic form, MINOTAUR uncovers and indicts the heart of societal darkness with searing clarity. Uniting intimately-drawn performances and stark visual power, this is peerless work from an indisputable master.

84366.title: La Bola Negra
84366.synopsis: LA BOLA NEGRA is a bold, passionate triptych spanning nearly a century of Spanish history from the 30s to modern day. The film tells the story of three men whose lives are intimately connected through desire, pain, and inheritance.

84370.title: The Only Living Pickpocket In New York
84370.synopsis: Harry Lehman (John Turturro) is an aging pickpocket who plies his trade with ever-diminishing returns in a drastically changed New York. Wallets stuffed with cash have been replaced by easily canceled credit cards, and Harry struggles to make ends meet as he cares for his disabled wife, Rosie. When he unwittingly purloins and fences a valuable USB stick, Harry finds himself in a race against time to return the loot or face the rage of a vengeful crime family.
84370.cast: Giancarlo Esposito, John Turturro, Will Price

84380.title: Danemark et les Iles Feroe - Les aventuriers voyageurs
84380.synopsis: In this documentary, at once a journey of discovery, an intimate exploration, and a reflection on quality of life, Tommy and his travel companion  Janie Lapointe  explore this realm shaped by water, wind, and a profoundly human philosophy of living. Here, urbanism meets nature, design meets tradition, and happiness is cultivated day after day.

84381.title: Iles de Guadeloupe - Les aventuriers voyageurs
84381.synopsis: Seeking freedom after years spent at the intense pace of the morning show Salut Bonjour, Gino Chouinard offers himself a complete immersion in the heart of the Guadeloupe Islands, a destination where lush nature, the sweetness of life and the Creole soul intertwine with strength.

84426.title: Queen Budapest
84426.synopsis: On July 27, 1986, Queen performed the largest-ever stadium concert at the Nepstadion in Budapest in front of 80,000 ecstatic fans. The concert was part of the famed Magic Tour, which was the last time the band toured with lead singer Freddie Mercury. Now, this original concert film has been beautifully rescanned and remastered in 4K alongside a dynamic new audio mix, featuring many of Queen's favorite tracks--'Bohemian Rhapsody,' 'Crazy Little Thing Called Love,' 'I Want To Break Free' and 'We Are The Champions.' With three years to go before the fall of the Berlin Wall, this was the first Western rock concert performed in a stadium behind the then Iron Curtain. It was of such significance to the Hungarian authorities and film industry that a group of the country's top film cameramen and technicians were brought together to film it for posterity
84426.cast: Brian May, Freddie Mercury, John Deacon

84428.title: Fallen Angels by Noël Coward
84428.synopsis:
Sparkling, dizzying, and deliciously potent, FALLEN ANGELS, Noel Coward's champagne-fresh comedy of bad manners, shocked and delighted audiences at its 1925 premiere. Two upper-class wives, their husbands away for the day, share a few toasts to their pre-marital dalliances--with the same man, who just may be en route from France to visit. Old rivalries and past scandals bubble to the surface in this intoxicating romp from one of theatre's comedy masters.

Starring Golden Globe-winner Rose Byrne (If I Had Legs I'd Kick You) and Tony Award winner Kelli O'Hara (The King and I), with Tracee Chimo, Mark Consuelos (making his Broadway debut), Christopher Fitzgerald and Aasif Mandvi, this new Roundabout Theatre and Tony Award-winning production of 'pure escapist fun' (The New York Times) was filmed live on stage at Broadway's Todd Haimes Theatre and now comes to the big screen.

84437.title: BTS WORLD TOUR 'ARIRANG' IN SAO PAULO: LIVE VIEWING
84437.synopsis: Experience the BTS WORLD TOUR 'ARIRANG' in cinemas worldwide, broadcasting from São Paulo, Brazil! Marking the grand finale of their Latin America tour, this monumental concert will bring the explosive energy of the packed stadium in Brazil straight to the big screen. Please note that broadcasts in some territories are scheduled later to accommodate local time zones.

84443.title: BTS WORLD TOUR 'ARIRANG' IN BUENOS AIRES: LIVE VIEWING
84443.synopsis: The first-ever BTS Live Viewing broadcast from South America. Experience the BTS WORLD TOUR 'ARIRANG' in cinemas worldwide, broadcasting from Buenos Aires, Argentina! Marking the first time the band has ever performed in Argentina, this monumental concert will bring the explosive energy of the packed stadium straight to the big screen. Please note that broadcasts in some territories are scheduled later to accommodate local time zones.

84449.title: The Debut
84449.synopsis: When Mona Friedman is cast in a bit part at a small community theater, she transforms from a shy, unassuming housewife into a zealous method actor willing to do anything to protect the artistic integrity of her marginal role--even if it means waging war against the show's domineering director.
84449.cast: Halle Bailey, Julianne Moore, Paul Giamatti

84452.title: The One
84452.synopsis: When 18-year-old Hawk ages out of the Chicago foster system, he sets out to see the lighting of the country's largest Christmas tree, the One. Carrying only his guitar and a few belongings, he faces homelessness and a harsh winter alone until he crosses paths with Jefferson, a mysterious traveler, and Alexis, a runaway teenager grieving the loss of her twin sister. Together, they embark on an unexpected journey of faith, hope, and healing.
84452.cast: Jana Kramer, Martin Sheen, Nick Zano

84453.title: If I Go Will They Miss Me
84453.synopsis: In the Watts neighborhood of Los Angeles, twelve-year-old Lil Ant sees the world and his father the way all children should — full of myth, wonder, and unwavering belief. If I Go Will They Miss Me is a breathtaking father-son story about imagination, family, and the grace we extend to the people we love.

84455.title: Conceivable
84455.synopsis: When respected minister Brielle Burns learns she's pregnant at 45, her carefully planned future unravels. Under scrutiny from family, friends, and her church, she must confront faith, fear, and responsibility to find courage to find in a life-changing season. Based on a true story, this inspiring drama explores the power of faith in life's most unexpected moments.
84455.cast: Dean Cain, Eddie McClintock, Jana Lee Hamblin

84492.title: A Talent for Murder
84492.synopsis: A mysterious young man from a New York publisher is sent to Switzerland to persuade the renowned writer Patricia Highsmith to write one final installment of the Ripley anthology.
84492.cast: Alden Ehrenreich, Helen Mirren, Olivia Cooke

84493.title: Club Kid
84493.synopsis: An organizer of underground parties is forced to take care of a son whose existence he was completely unaware of.
84493.cast: Cara Delevingne, Diego Calva, Miss Benny

84501.title: Tender Loving Care
84501.synopsis: Palme d'Or winner and Academy Award nominee Mike Leigh returns with his next feature film, continuing his insightful exploration of the contemporary world. With his distinctive cinematic voice, he once again delves into themes that challenge and resonate with modern audiences.
84501.cast: Kate O'Flynn, Marion Bailey, Paul Jesson

84502.title: Musk
84502.synopsis: An incisive look behind the legend of Elon Musk, the world's most heralded 'inventor-entrepreneur' who has enormous influence on the world in which we all live.

84505.title: Behemoth!
84505.synopsis: A gifted cellist, Alex Serian (Pedro Pascal), returns home to Los Angeles after 20 years on the road.  Music, which has been the constant, all-consuming river of his life, begins to carry Alex on an adventure that will change him forever.
84505.cast: Eva Victor, Olivia Wilde, Pedro Pascal

84512.title: All of a Sudden
84512.synopsis: Two scholars exchange letters about chance and risk. As the philosopher falls ill, their academic correspondence evolves into intimate discussions about mortality and a deeper connection forms between them.

84514.title: Clarissa
84514.synopsis: Based on Mrs. Dalloway. Follows a Lagos society wife preparing for a party while reflecting on her youth and the choices that led her to marry a respected man instead of her poet boyfriend.
84514.cast: Ayo Edebiri, David Oyelowo, Sophie Okonedo

84534.title: The Weird Kidz
84534.synopsis: When three pre-teen boys and an older brother and his girlfriend take off for a weekend campout, none of them could imagine the horrors (and laughs) awaiting them in a remote desert inhabited by a legendary night creature and crazed townfolk. Puberty and adventure await...along with terror, amputations and midnight cult rituals!
84534.cast: Angela Bettis, Ellar Coltrane, Sean Bridgers

84547.title: The King of Cannabis
84547.synopsis:
Guests under 17 must be accompanied by a guardian who is 21 or older. Please be prepared to show ID at the theatre. Inspired by true events. One man's relentless ambition. An empire that changed America forever.
After his father's sudden job loss shatters his working-class family, he enters the underground cannabis world searching for opportunity. While others see an illegal product, he sees the future of a billion-dollar industry.
Over three decades, he builds one of the most powerful cannabis networks in the country, navigating rival organizations, political corruption, international suppliers, and relentless federal investigations.
Convinced legalization is inevitable, he positions himself years ahead of the market, quietly helping shape the future of cannabis in America. As the walls close in, he embarks on the most dangerous gamble of his life, pushing legalization to the federal level before the government can dismantle everything he built.
Before the government could stop him, he changed the rules of the game. And in doing so, changed America forever.
84547.cast: Alimi Ballard, Charles Malik Whitfield, Luis Guzman

84564.title: Bitter Christmas
84564.synopsis: BITTER CHRISTMAS tells two alternating stories, one starring Elsa, an advertising director, in 2004, during a long weekend in December. The second takes place in 2026 and stars Raul, a screenwriter and director who is writing a script that we soon discover is the story of Elsa, her boyfriend Bonifacio, and her friends Patricia and Natalia. Mixed with fiction, Elsa is, in a way, Raul's alter ego, who, like him, resorts to autofiction as a solution to a long period of creative drought. He looks inside himself, and he can't help but also look at the people who make up his most intimate universe: his partner and his assistant.
84564.cast: Aitana Sanchez-Gijon, Barbara Lennie, Leonardo Sbaraglia, Victoria Luengo

84566.synopsis: Set in a medical college in a dread-stricken village, the film confronts the science behind superstitions, the superstitions in science, and an anomaly that neither can explain.

84571.title: Raise the Red Lantern (1991) (re)
84571.synopsis: Teenage Songlian (Gong Li), whose family has been devastated by the recent death of her father, becomes the third concubine of wealthy Master Chen. She soon discovers that behind the palatial luxury of life in the master's house, she and her fellow concubines are pitted against each other in a struggle for his affections. The situation inevitably leads to deception, jealous rages, and the revelation of each other's darkest secrets.

84575.title: One Eye Open
84575.synopsis: A recent college graduate house-sitting for her ailing grandfather finds herself caught in a deadly cat-and-mouse game with thieves who become haunted by something supernatural protecting her in the mysterious mansion, and she turns the tables and makes them pay.

84602.title: George Michael: The Faith Tour
84602.synopsis: An electric concert film featuring recently rediscovered, never-before-seen footage of the global superstar at the Palais Omnisports de Paris-Bercy during the European leg of the Faith Tour in 1988. A triumph in archival filmmaking, George Michael: The Faith Tour transforms footage assembled from a 14-camera shoot captured on 35mm film over two nights, into an extraordinary cinematic event and audio experience.

84605.title: Primetime
84605.synopsis:
In 2006, To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen sets out to make 
television history.
84605.cast: Merritt Wever, Robert Pattinson, Skyler Gisondo

84607.title: Adore Him: He is Here
84607.synopsis: ADORE HIM is a new docudrama that invites you to enter the very presence of God. Through cinematic reenactments that span salvation history and intimate modern-day interviews from around the world, this film explores the transforming power of meeting the Creator of the Universe face to face. ADORE HIM is the squeal to the Gabriel Award-winning Jesus Thirsts: The Miracle of the Eucharist. From encountering the Ark of the Covenant as it traveled across the wilderness to bumping into Jesus as he taught in the marketplace, this story builds to a culmination in the Eucharist, and today millions are finding out how much God truly loves them as they adore Him in the Blessed Sacrament. He is here. Will you come?

84619.title: Dead of Night
84619.synopsis: When a small town is terrorized by a series of brutal murders, the sheriff, his daughter, and a desperate mayor race to uncover the truth.
84619.cast: Dermot Mulroney, Kirrilee Berger, Scott Grimes

84620.title: Everest: The Other Side
84620.synopsis: An intimate portrait of two people bound by love, ambition, and the pursuit of the impossible. Elite ski mountaineers Jim Morrison and Hilaree Nelson fell deeply in love while reaching the pinnacle of their sport. Their drive sharpened into a shared dream: to climb and ski the direct North Face of Mount Everest - the most difficult and dangerous climb on the mountain and the most coveted ski line on Earth - something only a handful have ever achieved, and no one has successfully skied down.

84636.title: Elsinore
84636.synopsis: The deeply emotional and inspirational true story of Ian Charleson, a gifted actor whose greatest challenge becomes his greatest triumph. Facing his own mortality with unflinching honesty, wit, and grace, Charleson delivers a courageous performance that becomes a source of healing and inspiration for those around him.
84636.cast: Andrew Scott, Billie Piper, Olivia Colman

84637.title: Queen at Sea
84637.synopsis: Amanda and her stepfather Martin struggle with a moral issue that divides them. Has Amanda's mother Leslie, who has dementia, lost the ability to make critical decisions in her own best interests? And, if so, who is responsible -- a spouse, a child, an institution -- for making such a determination? As Amanda and Martin are forced to make increasingly difficult choices, the repercussions spiral out of their control. Academy Award winner Juliette Binoche (The Taste of Things), Academy Award nominee Tom Courtenay (45 Years), Anna Calder-Marshall (Wuthering Heights), and Florence Hunt (Bridgerton) star in this unflinching drama. The film won the Silver Bear Jury Prize and Tom Courtenay and Anna Calder-Marshall won the Silver Bear for Best Supporting Performance at the 2026 Berlin International Film Festival.
84637.cast: Juliette Binoche, Lolabelle Backus, Mohammad Amiri

84684.title: Donnie Darko 25th Anniversary
84684.synopsis:
Celebrate 25 years of Richard Kelly's mind-bending masterpiece in a stunning 4K presentation. Donnie Darko doesn't get along with his family, teachers, or classmates, but he finds a kindred spirit in Gretchen and guidance from a compassionate psychiatrist who believes hypnosis may unlock hidden truths. Meanwhile, Donnie is haunted by Frank, a mysterious giant bunny only he can see. When a jet engine crashes into his bedroom and narrowly misses him, Donnie is drawn into a series of increasingly strange events that seem governed by forces beyond explanation.

This special anniversary release also includes an exclusive introduction with writer & director Richard Kelly exploring the film's enduring legacy, how it captivated audiences for 25 years, and why it remains one of the defining cult classics of the new millennium.
84684.cast: Drew Barrymore, Jake Gyllenhaal, Mary McDonnell

84709.title: Fresh Meat
84709.synopsis: Only one will make the cut.

84717.title: April X
84717.synopsis: When his twin sister April (Lilly Krug) goes missing, Bax (Connor Storrie) searches every corner of their futuristic, post-Soviet cityscape to find her.  Ultimately descending into a violet criminal underworld and madness, Bax is forced to confront the cost of identity, love and survival.

84718.title: King
84718.synopsis: Mentor and disciple embark on a perilous journey, pushing their survival skills to the limit against overwhelming odds and unforgiving environments.

84722.title: Avengers: Doomsday RealD 3D Fan Event
84722.synopsis: Join us on December 20 for a special RealD 3D Fan Event screening of Marvel Studios' Avengers: Doomsday. Every guest receives a pair of collectible 3D glasses featuring one of five mystery logos. Which universe will you represent: The Avengers, Black Panther, X-Men, Fantastic Four, or the elusive Dr. Doom. Which pair will you get?

84724.title: Ozzy & Black Sabbath: Back To The Beginning
84724.synopsis:
OZZY & BLACK SABBATH: BACK TO THE BEGINNING documents a landmark moment in music history: Ozzy Osbourne's historic final farewell performance for his fans at Villa Park stadium in his Birmingham hometown--captured just 17 days before his untimely passing. The film highlights the historic day with performances from Ozzy, Black Sabbath, and some of the most influential names in rock, along with personal reflections from the superstar musicians they inspired and a behind-the-scenes look at the day itself.

This is an historic and intimate farewell to Ozzy and the band that changed music forever.

84725.title: ALWAYS LALISA
84725.synopsis:
ALWAYS LALISA is a feature-length documentary following global superstar LISA during a transformative year away from Blackpink, the K-pop phenomenon that made her one of the world's most recognizable performers. As the group pauses activities, LISA embarks on the first true chapter of her solo career, confronting the question of who she is beyond Blackpink.

The film follows LISA as she writes, records, and releases her debut solo album, Alter Ego, makes her acting debut in the third season of The White Lotus, and prepares for her first major solo performance at the 2025 Coachella Music Festival. Born and raised in Thailand, LISA left home at fourteen to train in South Korea's demanding K-pop system, ultimately rising to global superstardom. But forging her own path, particularly in the Western music market, brings new pressures, relentless scrutiny, and the challenge of redefining herself on her own terms.

Intimate, emotional, and revealing, Always Lalisa captures an artist at a crossroads, documenting a year of risk, reinvention, and self-discovery as LISA begins to define not only her next chapter, but the woman and artist she wants to become.

84735.title: Yuri!!! on ICE 10th Anniversary
84735.synopsis: Celebrate the 10th anniversary of YURI!! ON ICE on the big screen with Crunchyroll Anime Nights! See Yuri's story from the beginning with the first 5 episodes of this classic series.

84741.title: Ink
84741.synopsis: The film is based on the Tony-nominated play by multi-Olivier award-winning playwright and screenwriter James Graham. The film is an explosive cinematic rollercoaster about a group of visionaries and misfits who had an idea for a new kind of news -- one that would give the people what they want and would change the face of the world we live in today.
84741.cast: Claire Foy, Guy Pearce, Jack O'Connell

84750.title: Ken Russell's The Devils
84750.synopsis: Oliver Reed plays a French priest ( Urbain Grandier) in the 17th century. He is at odds with the church due to his radical political and religious opinions. When he appears to have influenced a group of nuns with his beliefs, he is arrested and tortured.

84764.title: The Influencer Project
84764.synopsis:
In THE INFLUENCER PROJECT, real-life content creator Chiara King travels to Copenhagen with a documentary crew promising an unfiltered look behind the glamorous business of online fame. But as the cameras and her devoted fans follow her every move, someone else is watching too. When an obsessive stalker begins closing in, the documentary becomes something far more terrifying, blurring the line between content and evidence, follower and predator, fact and fiction. From the visionary creators of THE BLAIR WITCH PROJECT comes a chilling descent into a new generation of fear, influenced by actual events.

From the visionary creators of THE BLAIR WITCH PROJECT comes a chilling descent into a new generation of fear, influenced by actual events.

84768.title: Dune: Part Three Insider Screenings
84768.synopsis: THE JOURNEY TO ARRAKIS BEGINS. This early showing is intended for Dune Insiders—fans who have opted into the film’s official Insider program for a direct connection to the campaign, including updates, special content and more.

84773.title: GIANT - The Play
84773.synopsis:
GIANT, the 5-star critically acclaimed play starring John Lithgow (Killers of the Flower Moon, The Crown) as Roald Dahl, comes to the big screen. Winner of 3 Olivier Awards? including Best Play and a Tony Award? for Best Actor in a Play (John Lithgow), the production was filmed live in London's West End ahead of its sold-out Broadway run. The stellar cast includes Aya Cash (The Boys, The Franchise, You're the Worst), Elliot Levey (Cold War, Patriots, Good) and Rachael Stirling (The Divine Mrs S).
 
A world-famous children's author under threat. A battle of wills in the wake of scandal. And one chance to make amends...It's the summer of 1983, The Witches is about to hit the shelves and Roald Dahl is making last-minute edits.  But the outcry at his recent, explicitly antisemitic article won't die down. Across a single afternoon at his family home, and rocked by an unexpectedly explosive confrontation, Dahl is forced to choose: make a public apology or risk his name and reputation. Inspired by real events, GIANT explores with dark humour the difference between considered opinion and dangerous rhetoric offering a complicated portrait of a fiendishly charismatic icon.

84777.title: SPIRITED AWAY: Live on Stage - Studio Ghibli Fest 2026
84777.synopsis: Hayao Miyazaki?s Academy Award?-winning animated feature film comes to life in this first-ever stage adaptation, full of dazzling sets, captivating musical numbers, and wondrous puppets of beloved characters. Adapted and directed by Tony Award?-winner John Caird (Les Miserables), two unique casts and performances were filmed during the show?s acclaimed 2022 run at Tokyo?s historic Imperial Theatre, featuring Kanna Hashimoto and Mone Kamishiraishi as Chihiro.

84786.title: Gradiva, La
84786.synopsis: A class of high school students travels to Pompeii to discover ruins and bodies petrified by Vesuvius. The trip becomes a rare moment when the force of youth meets a world frozen in time. Their desires start to surface with unexpected intensity, leading them toward an irreversible fracture.

84788.title: Terrestrial (dir. Pink)
84788.synopsis: During a weekend reunion, a rising sci-fi author welcomes three college friends to his home but strange events begin to blur the lines between reality and imagination.
84788.cast: James Morosini, Jermaine Fowler, Pauline Chalamet

84795.title: Ghost in the Cell
84795.synopsis: Guests under 17 must be accompanied by a guardian who is 21 or older. Please be prepared to show ID at the theatre. Director Joko Anwar plunges viewers into a high-security prison ruled by feuding gangs and a tyrannical warden. The arrival of a new inmate kicks off a series of mysterious gruesome murders that leave its victims on morbid display. The hapless inmates trapped in the prison must overcome their rivalries to unmask an invisible, otherworldly enemy. No one is safe as the cells cage in the horrors and a ghost roams the prison with murderous intent.

84827.title: Hostel 20th Anniversary - Welcome to Horrorwood Series
84827.synopsis:

Remastered in 4K. Three backpackers head to a Slovak city that promises to meet their hedonistic expectations, with no idea of the hell that awaits them.

84828.title: Friday The 13th - Welcome to Horrorwood Series
84828.synopsis: A group of teenage camp counselors attempt to re-open an abandoned summer camp with a tragic past, but they are stalked by a mysterious, relentless killer.

84829.title: American Psycho - Welcome to Horrorwood Series
84829.synopsis: A wealthy New York City investment banking executive, Patrick Bateman, hides his alternate psychopathic ego from his co-workers and friends as he delves deeper into his violent, hedonistic fantasies.

84830.title: Pet Sematary  - Welcome to Horrorwood Series
84830.synopsis: After tragedy strikes, a grieving father discovers an ancient burial ground behind his home with the power to raise the dead.

84831.title: The Crow - Welcome to Horrorwood Series
84831.synopsis: The night before his wedding, musician Eric Draven and his fiancée are brutally murdered by members of a violent gang. On the anniversary of their death, Eric rises from the grave and assumes the mantle of the Crow, a supernatural avenger.

84847.title: V For Vendetta 20th Anniversary
84847.synopsis: Set against the futuristic landscape of totalitarian Britain, V FOR VENDETTA tells the story of a mild-mannered young woman named Evey (NATALIE PORTMAN) who is rescued from a life-and-death situation by a masked man (HUGO WEAVING) known only as 'V.' Incomparably charismatic and ferociously skilled in the art of combat and deception, V ignites a revolution when he urges his fellow citizens to rise up against tyranny and oppression. As Evey uncovers the truth about V's mysterious background, she also discovers the truth about herself - and emerges as his unlikely ally in the culmination of his plan to bring freedom and justice back to a society fraught with cruelty and corruption.

84866.title: Itllu Arjuna
84866.synopsis: Follows a mute man with exceptional skills who falls in love, proving that true feelings do not always need words.

84880.title: Josephine
84880.synopsis: After 8-year-old Josephine accidentally witnesses a crime in Golden Gate Park, she acts out in search of a way to regain control of her safety, while adults are helpless to console her.
84880.cast: Channing Tatum, Gemma Chan, Mason Reeves, Philip Ettinger

84881.title: The Incomer
84881.synopsis: On a remote Scottish isle, siblings Isla and Sandy hunt birds and talk to mythical beings while fighting off outsiders. Their lives change when Daniel, an awkward official, arrives to relocate them.
84881.cast: Domhnall Gleeson, John Hannah, Michelle Gomez

84888.title: Who Killed Alex Odeh?
84888.synopsis: In October 1985, Santa Ana, California was shaken by a brazen act of political violence when Palestinian American Alex Odeh, a beloved teacher and community leader, was killed by a tripwire bomb planted in his office. Despite substantial evidence and identified suspects, the case was never solved. WHO KILLED ALEX ODEH? reopens the mystery, tracking a renewed investigation in real time as new leads emerge, long-buried records come to light, and the forces behind a political assassination are finally confronted.

84893.title: The Nightmare Before Christmas (RE26)
84893.synopsis: Jack Skellington, king of Halloween Town, discovers Christmas Town, but his attempts to bring Christmas to his home causes confusion.

84904.title: Stand and Deliver
84904.synopsis: The true story of Jaime Escalante, the East Los Angeles mathematics teacher who challenges the system and the stereotypes to raise the standard of life for his inner-city students.

84905.title: Instructions Not Included
84905.synopsis: From Lionsgate and Pantelion Films.  Valentin (Eugenio Derbez) is Acapulco's resident playboy--until a former fling leaves a baby on his doorstep and takes off without a trace. Valentin leaves Mexico for Los Angeles to find the baby's mother, but only ends up finding a new home for himself and his newfound child, Maggie (Loreto Peralta). An unlikely father figure, Valentin raises Maggie for six years, while also establishing himself as one of Hollywood's top stuntmen to pay the bills, with Maggie acting as his on-set coach. As Valentin raises Maggie, she forces him to grow up too. But their unique and offbeat family is threatened when Maggie's birth mom shows up out of the blue, and Valentin realizes he's in danger of losing his daughter- and his best friend.

84921.title: UFC 333: Volkanovski vs. Evloev
84921.synopsis: UFC’s annual October showcase in Abu Dhabi has historically been packed with action, and this year is no different as a pair of highly anticipated championship fights close out UFC 333 at Etihad Arena. In the main event, two-time featherweight champion Alexander “The Great” Volkanovski defends his title for the second time this year, taking on the challenge of undefeated Russian contender Movsar Evloev. And in the co-main event, bantamweight rivals battle for a third time as two- time titleholder Petr “No Mercy” Yan squares off with former champion Merab “The Machine” Dvalishvili to determine which of them will lord over the 135-pound weight class heading into next year.

84927.title: On the Road
84927.synopsis: A drifter who sleeps with truckers meets a reserved driver and joins him hauling freight across northern Mexico. As they grow closer on the road, the drifter's past threatens them both.

84930.title: Autre, L'
84930.synopsis: A cancer surgery patient faces both imagined threats and real perils during recovery.
84930.cast: Bilel Chegrani, Maxime Genois, Pierre-Yves Cardinal

84943.title: Mouse
84943.synopsis: When an introverted high-schooler in small-town Arkansas loses her best friend to a car accident, she forms an unexpected bond with her friend's mother while navigating the fraught, fragile, and often funny stages of grief.
84943.cast: Chloe Coleman, Katherine Mallen Kupferer, Sophie Okonedo

84950.title: Portrait of an Artist: Stephen Curry
84950.synopsis:
On the verge of his record-extending 4,000th career three-pointer, four-time NBA champion and two-time MVP Stephen Curry reflects on the upbringing, mindset and work ethic that have made him among the most legendary artists of our time. The film captures Curry leading up to and throughout one remarkable game, weaving together his generational artistry with perspectives from other innovative artists - including Viola Davis, Rick Rubin, Patti Smith and Jon Batiste - showcasing how his singular vision has permanently transformed the game of basketball.

This state-of-the-art production utilized 21 IMAX-certified cameras to capture the urgency and emotion around this historic single day and single game.

When Curry hit his 4,000th career three-pointer, it wasn't just another record - it was something the league had literally never seen before. Curry entered the home game at Chase Center against the Sacramento Kings needing just two threes to reach the unprecedented milestone of 4,000 career three-pointers. Curry became the first player in NBA history to reach this historic milestone. The Warriors went on to win the game 130-104.

84958.title: SB19 Wakas at Simula: The Trilogy Concert Finale in Cinemas
84958.synopsis: From the Philippines to the world, SB19's historic WAKAS AT SIMULA: THE TRILOGY CONCERT FINALE comes to cinemas worldwide. Captured before a record-breaking crowd of nearly 100,000 fans, the film showcases the group's biggest hits, spectacular production, and world class performances that have made SB19 one of Asia's most influential acts. Presented in SCREENX and 4DX at participating theatres, audiences can experience the scale, sound, and energy of the concert like never before. Experience the power of GENTO, What?, and DAM as the Philippines' biggest pop phenomenon takes over the big screen in an unforgettable celebration of music, fandom, and legacy. More than a concert film, it is the story of a movement--one built by five artists, millions of fans, and a dream that helped redefine Filipino music for a new generation.

84967.title: The Beast
84967.synopsis: When a militia of unidentified hostiles coordinates a coup against the U.S., the president uncovers the extent of The Beast's highly classified offensive capabilities in order to save his life and America.

84972.title: Back to the Future Day 2026
84972.synopsis: When teenager Marty McFly (Michael J. Fox) is blasted to 1955 in the DeLorean time machine created by the eccentric Doc Brown (Christopher Lloyd), he finds himself mixed up in a time-altering chain reaction that could vaporize his future -- and leave him trapped in the past.

84975.title: & Sons
84975.synopsis: A writer tries to reconnect with his sons. Based on the novel by David Gilbert.
84975.cast: Bill Nighy, Dominic West, Imelda Staunton

84985.title: Forgotten Island: Sensory Friendly Screening
84985.synopsis: Your best friendship is worth fighting for.

84988.title: Marie Antoinette (20th Anniversary)
84988.synopsis: A vibrant retelling of the classic story of Marie Antoinette, the naive Austrian princess who is thrown into the scandal-ridden world of the French aristocracy when she is betrothed to King Louis XVI. While still a teenager, Marie Antoinette conquers her fears & becomes France's iconic queen.

84989.title: Everybody Digs Bill Evans
84989.synopsis: June 1961, New York. Legendary jazz pianist Bill Evans has found his musical voice and created the perfect trio, including bass player Scott LaFaro, his musical soulmate. A residency at New York's Village Vanguard culminates in the live taping of two of the greatest jazz records of all time in one day. Days later, LaFaro dies tragically in a car crash. Numb with grief, Evans stops playing for the first time since childhood. This is the story of what happened next for one of the most influential and gifted figures in 20th Century music. Grant Gee won Best Director at the 2026 Berlin International Film Festival.
84989.cast: Anders Danielsen Lie, Bill Pullman, Laurie Metcalf

84990.title: Making Marie Antoinette
84990.synopsis:
In 2005, Sofia Coppola shot her third feature film, Marie Antoinette, starring Kirsten Dunst and Jason Schwartzman, at the Palace of Versailles, securing unprecedented filming permission that had never before been granted to any production. Her mother, acclaimed documentarian Eleanor Coppola, accompanied her on set, capturing approximately eighty hours of footage chronicling her daughter's journey throughout the making of the film. This year, on the occasion of the 20th anniversary of the release of Marie Antoinette and in fulfilment of her mother's wish, Sofia Coppola edited that previously unseen material. Making Marie Antoinette explores the craftsmanship and care that brought the film to life, follows legendary costume designer Milena Canonero at work, and offers a glimpse into what it meant to be a young female director at that time. The result is a fascinating look at the creative process behind a landmark film and, at the same time, a surprisingly intimate family portrait.

In the documentary, Eleanor Coppola's voice is performed by Academy Award nominee Diane Lane, who reads excerpts from Eleanor's diaries, in which the filmmaker recounts her experience on set and reflects on her relationship with her daughter.

84991.title: Ramayana
84991.synopsis: RAMAYANA is based on an ancient Epic still celebrated by billions across the globe. RAMA, a prince bound by duty and sacrifice, must confront RAVANA, an immortal ruler driven by pride and vengeance. Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, with music and score by Hans Zimmer and A.R. Rahman.

84992.title: Thappi
84992.synopsis:
At seventy, undefeated wrestler Bhakhtaur Singh is haunted by a legacy his son refused to continue. When his grandson remains childless, Bhakhtaur demands a male heir. Instead, his daughter-in-law Kammo forms a girls' kabaddi team to
restore the family's pride. Facing patriarchy, threats and ridicule, six village girls rise against all odds. Their biggest challenge comes against New Zealand's national team, forcing Bhakhtaur to confront his pride and embrace Kammo as his successor.
84992.cast: Hashneen Chauhan, Neeru Bajwa, Sunny Singh

84993.title: Hell House LLC 10th Anniversary
84993.synopsis: Five years after an unexplained malfunction causes the death of 15 tour-goers and staff on the opening night of a Halloween haunted house tour, a documentary crew travels back to the scene of the tragedy to find out what really happened.

84996.advisory: AMC has been advised that this film contains sequences with flashing lights that may affect photosensitive viewers.

84997.title: Rose
84997.synopsis: In the turmoil of the Thirty-Years' War, a mysterious soldier appears in a secluded Protestant village claiming to be heir to a long-abandoned manor. His quest for recognition and acceptance are complicated by his secret: under a false identity, false name, and pretense of a false gender, he has made his way to the village. But to achieve her goals, Rose, as the soldier is actually called, will stop at nothing.

84999.title: Kung Fu Soccer
84999.synopsis: An unlikely women's football team from Mount Emei is written off from the start -- dismissed for their age, lack of experience, and slim chances of success. Everything changes when they unlock extraordinary martial arts-inspired abilities that transform their game, propelling them from underdogs to championship contenders. But as victories mount and their dream of glory comes within reach, an unexpected betrayal threatens to tear the team apart. Forced to regroup after a crushing setback, they must rethink their strategy, overcome their differences, and rediscover the power of teamwork. Facing an undefeated reigning champion in the ultimate showdown, they will need more than extraordinary skills -- they must outthink, outplay, and outmanoeuvre their opponents. Can this unlikely team overcome the odds and achieve the impossible? From visionary filmmaker Stephen Chow, Kung Fu Soccer delivers a crowd-pleasing blend of spectacular football action, martial arts fantasy, comedy, and heart -- an uplifting story about friendship, perseverance, and the pursuit of the impossible.

September 6. This high-speed Italian track has the designation of being the fastest in Formula 1, making it exactly the kind of setting IMAX was made for. Hug every turn and feel the rumble in your seat when you take your experience into IMAXimum overdrive.

85010.title: Rocky 50th Anniversary
85010.synopsis:
Struggling Philadelphia boxer Rocky Balboa has a chance to become a somebody when heavyweight champion Apollo Creed come up with the Bicentennial gimmick of fighting a sure-ringer and easily winning the bout himself. But someone forgot to tell Rocky, who trains earnestly. And in the climactic fight sequence, the "Italian Stallion" gets his wish: to go the distance...against all the odds!

Rocky 50 will also feature an exclusive look at the widely-anticipated biographical feature film, I Play Rocky, a Baha Fireside Production from Amazon MGM Studios and directed by Academy Award®- winning director Peter Farrelly (Green Book, There’s Something About Mary), alongside an introduction from the I Play Rocky cast.

85011.title: Moonlight 10th Anniversary Remastered
85011.synopsis: A timeless story of human connection and self-discovery, MOONLIGHT chronicles the life of a young black man from childhood to adulthood as he struggles to find his place in the world while growing up in a rough neighborhood of Miami. This groundbreaking film is both a vital portrait of contemporary African American life and a deeply personal and poetic meditation on identity, family, friendship, and love.

85014.title: Fantome de l'Opera, Le
