85041.title: The Victoria's Secret Fashion Show 2026
85041.synopsis: See the Victoria's Secret Fashion Show on the Big Screen. Grab your friends and get a front-row seat to see the Victoria's Secret Fashion Show LIVE on the big screen at select AMC locations. Don't miss out on special photo ops, exclusive merch, and more!

85042.title: The North
85042.synopsis: Two male friends in their early thirties reunite after a decade apart to hike Scotland's grueling 330-mile West Highland Way and Cape Wrath Trail on a journey filled with overwhelming natural beauty, unexpected epiphanies and life-changing self-discovery.

85044.title: Orfeo
85044.synopsis: In the classic Greek tragedy, a snake bites Eurydice on her wedding day, and her new husband, Orpheus, travels to the Underworld to bring her back. Virgilio Villoresi's expressionistic adaptation of the tale is based on Dino Buzzati's 1969 Poema a fumetti, Italy's first graphic novel. The film is a modern reimagining with an aesthetic untethered from reality: a kaleidoscopic journey through time and place, reflecting on art, love, mystery, eroticism, melancholy, life, and death.
85044.cast: Aomi Muyock, Giulia Maenza, Luca Vergoni

85058.title: In the Mouth
85058.synopsis: A perpetual worrywart finds himself unable to leave his house after discovering a giant version of himself protruding from his front lawn.
85058.cast: Colin Burgess, Paul Rothery, Sage Francis

85061.title: Street Fighter: Bonus Round Fan Event
85061.synopsis:
Set in 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu (Andrew Koji) and Ken Masters (Noah Centineo) are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li (Callina Liang) recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don’t, it’s GAME OVER!
Helmed by director Kitao Sakurai, Street Fighter is set to bring the battle from the arcade to the big screen with Hadoukens, roundhouses, and all your favorite characters.

85064.title: You Can't Leave
85064.synopsis: A search for a missing friend turns into a supernatural nightmare. In a dark forest, an abandoned cabin hides an ancient evil. As night falls, friends must survive pursuit, escape the shadows, and uncover the truth before it's too late.
85064.cast: Paola Andino, Spencer Boldman, Thomas Bauer

85066.title: Breeder
85066.synopsis: An eccentric poodle breeder lures a broke college student to her remote ranch with a promise of research funding. But, as he soon learns, there's a catch.
85066.cast: Daniel Doheny, Dot-Marie Jones, Maddie Philips

85072.title: Elf
85072.synopsis: A human baby raised as an elf. A city where no one remembers the true meaning of Christmas. Will Ferrell (Saturday Night Live, Superstar) stars as Buddy, a human raised in the North Pole to be an elf. After wreaking havoc in the elf community due to his size, Buddy heads to New York City to find his place in the world, and track down his father. But life in the big city is not all sugarplums and candy canes. His father is a 'Scrooge' and his eight-year-old stepbrother doesn't believe in Santa. Even the snowmen aren't friendly in New York. In fact, they don't even speak. Worst of all, everyone has forgotten the true meaning of Christmas, and it's up to Buddy and his simple elf ways to win over his family, realize his destiny and, ultimately, save Christmas for New York and the world. Directed by John Favreau (Swingers), Elf is a warm-hearted Christmas comedy written by David Berenbaum.

85073.title: The Polar Express
85073.synopsis: On Christmas Eve, a young boy embarks on a magical adventure to the North Pole on the Polar Express, while learning about friendship, bravery, and the spirit of Christmas.

85074.title: Dr. Seuss' How The Grinch Stole Christmas
85074.synopsis: The curmudgeonly recluse Grinch, who hates Christmas, becomes annoyed with the out-of-control Christmas festivities in Whoville, the town lying below his cave dwelling on Mt. Crumpit. But after the Grinch conspires to deprive the Who's of their favorite holiday by sneaking into town on Christmas eve to steal everything associated with the holiday, he learns that the spirit of Christmas goes much deeper than tinsel and toys.

85075.title: Love Actually (HFS26)
85075.synopsis: Follows the lives of eight very different couples in dealing with their love lives in various loosely interrelated tales all set during a frantic month before Christmas in London, England.

85076.title: Bad Santa
85076.synopsis: Two con men masquerade as Santa Claus and an elf, knocking off shopping malls. But then they meet an 8-year-old boy, who unintentionally reminds them about the true meaning of Christmas.

85077.title: Gremlins
85077.synopsis: With its Christmas lights and dusting of snow, Kingston Falls is an idyllic small town--until the gremlins take over. A father returns from Chinatown with an unusual pet, a Mogwai--a gift for his son. The rules are simple: Keep your Mogwai away from water, bright lights and, most importantly, never--never--feed him after midnight. But the rules are inadvertently broken, and the consequences multiply at an alarming rate.

85078.title: Scrooged
85078.synopsis: High-spirited high jinks on Christmas Eve put Frank Cross (Bill Murray) in a ghostly time warp in this hilarious take-off of Charles Dickens' A Christmas Carol. Cross, who has made the meteoric rise from the depths of the mail room to TV network president, is mean, nasty, uncaring, unforgiving and has a sadistic sense of humor - perfect qualities for a modern-day Scrooge. Before the night is over, he'll be visited by a maniacal New York cab driver from the past, a present-day fairy who’s into pratfalls and, finally, a ghoulish, seven-foot headless messenger from the future.

85086.title: Secret Lives of Baba Segi's Wives
85086.synopsis: A rich patriarch's delicate family falls apart when his youngest of four wives cannot have a child.
85086.cast: Bimbo Ademoye, Mercy Aigbe, Odunlade Adekola

85087.title: Agbara Nla (1993) (re)
85087.cast: Bola Adepoju, Sis Adeleke, Veronica Adejayan

85089.title: Long Day's Journey Into Night
85089.synopsis: Set on one single day in August 1912 at the family's Connecticut seaside home, the story follows the Tyrone family as it faces the looming dual spectres of Edmund's potentially fatal consumption diagnosis alongside his mother Mary's increasingly fragile and anxious state of mind. The family knows that the situation threatens to return her to the severe morphine addiction that was only recently overcome. Starring Jessica Lange, Ed Harris, Ben Foster, and Colin Morgan, based on the play by Eugene O'Neill.
85089.cast: Ben Foster, Ed Harris, Jessica Lange

85101.title: Don't Trouble the Trouble
85101.synopsis: Follows Suri, a magician, who accidentally makes a young girl vanish with a spell. The girl, revealed to be a genie who grants wishes, explores the city and unleashes her powers when angered.

85107.title: Andre Rieu's 2026 Christmas Concert: Let it Snow!
85107.synopsis: Known to millions as `The King of Waltz?, Andre Rieu is the world?s leading pop classical artist and consistently appears on the worldwide list of highest-grossing touring artists.

85115.title: Paging Hezbollah
85115.synopsis: PAGING HEZBOLLAH reveals how Israel pulled off one of the most audacious intelligence operations in history - engineering, marketing, and smuggling a modern-day Trojan Horse into Hezbollah's command network before destroying it with a single beep. Told by those who lived and planned it, this is the little-known story of ingenuity, deception and an operation decades in the making.

85132.title: Rise and Shine
85132.synopsis:
Rise and Shine follows Terri, a young woman with cerebral palsy, as she pursues friendship, independence, belonging, and her lifelong dream of attending high school and prom. Based on the true story and memoir Remembering Terri by Janice Steele, the film stars Ana Sharp, an actress with cerebral palsy, in the lead role, alongside Rachel Bay Jones, Danny Burstein, Jordan Walker Ross and Analesa Fisher. 

Rise and Shine is built to entertain broad audiences while advancing authentic disability representation.

85133.title: Soul Patrol
85133.synopsis: Soul Patrol uncovers a hidden chapter of American military history by focusing on the Vietnam War's first Black special ops team, an elite unit operating deep behind enemy lines. With unprecedented access to this once-secretive group of African-American veterans, director J.M. Harper reconstructs their journey with an immediacy rarely seen in Vietnam War storytelling, using raw Super 8 footage, photographs, and audio recordings from their personal archives. Opening on the war?s 50th anniversary, the surviving members reunite in a hotel that becomes a surreal liminal space, where memory, brotherhood, and unresolved trauma collide. As the men reflect on their experiences, the film interrogates the contradictions of fighting for freedom abroad while facing inequality at home. Winner of the Directing Award for U.S. Documentary at the Sundance Film Festival, Soul Patrol is not just a war story, but a reckoning ? an intimate portrait of survival, memory, and the enduring cost of war on those asked to fight it.

85135.title: Villeneuve: L'ascension d'une legende
85135.cast: Joe Cobden, Luc Picard, Neil Webb

85139.title: Once Upon A Time in the Middle East
85139.synopsis: One of China's biggest stars, Shen Teng, leads the acclaimed international box office sensation ONCE UPON A TIME IN THE MIDDLE EAST. Seeking a fresh start, chef Xu Fu travels to the Middle East to support his family and repay his debts. Alongside restaurant manager Ma Junsheng, he transforms the struggling Dragon Restaurant into a thriving business. But when war engulfs the city, their hard-won success is shattered and the restaurant becomes a refuge for those caught in the conflict. As danger closes in, Xu Fu must risk everything to protect his newfound community and preserve a small beacon of hope amid the devastation.
85139.cast: Omar Sharif, Qiming Jiang, Teng Shen

85142.title: You Can See Everything
85142.synopsis: Thirty-four days before she's sent to prison, notorious Silicon Valley founder Elizabeth Holmes invites a skeptical film crew to document her every move. What begins as an intimate portrait of an enigmatic felon becomes a mind-bending three-year journey into the abyss. From boundary-pushing directors Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim comes YOU CAN SEE EVERYTHING.

85151.title: V
85151.synopsis: In the early 1990s, this city of desire, once "paved with gold," had fallen into a state of broken order and rampant crime. Man Zi-Keung (Zhu Yilong), a worker, is determined to rewrite his fate. After meeting flight attendant Lok Ka-Yuen (Michelle Wai), the two join forces to commit a heist, seizing a huge sum of money. This success drives Man Zi-Keung to ever greater extremes, pushing him and wealthy businessman Chan Fai-Yin (Leung Ka Fai ) deeper into a vortex of escalating confrontation. Meanwhile, mainland police officer Qi Honggang (Tan Jianci) and Hong Kong police officer Kwan So-San (Selena Lee) persist in investigating Man Zi-Keung. With the two police forces joining hands, the clash between good and evil is on the verge of eruption.
85151.cast: Jianci Tan, Tony Leung, Yilong Zhu

85155.title: The Renaissance of Oddity Todd
85155.synopsis: In a world governed by the authoritarian World Collective, the Sonus are a secretive order of scholars whose study of Vibrational Energy grants them supernatural abilities. When a mysterious event draws the World Collective's attention to their existence, the Sonus are forced into hiding. As the conflict escalates, a deeper evil emerges and a Sonus named Todd, haunted by a cryptic past, finds himself humanity's last hope against a dark reckoning.
85155.cast: Darrin Hickok, Franko Cruz, Tamara Fay

85156.title: Seniors
85156.synopsis: A teen serving community service at a retirement home bonds with a former war correspondent on a secret treasure hunt, finding friendship, purpose, and unexpected allies along their misadventure-filled journey.

85163.title: Vampire Carnival
85163.synopsis: Haunted by her past, a grieving girl is drawn to a mysterious traveling carnival that arrives in her small town - only to discover an underground world that feeds on despair and demands a costly price for escape.
85163.cast: Jason Isaacs, Nell Verlaque, Paulina Chavez

85171.title: Sense and Sensibility: Early Access Movie Party
85171.synopsis: From Focus Features and Working Title comes an irresistible new take on Jane Austen?s iconic Sense and Sensibility: a charming, witty, and deeply relatable story of love and sisterhood starring Daisy Edgar-Jones and Esme Creed-Miles.

85173.title: Verity: Sensory Friendly Screening
85173.synopsis: Struggling writer Lowen Ashleigh is hired as a ghostwriter for renowned author Verity Crawford under mysterious circumstances, but her assignment takes a dark turn after discovering chilling autobiographical notes. Faced with a series of deadly family secrets, Lowen struggles to separate fiction from reality, while also blurring the lines with Verity's husband, Jeremy.

85182.title: World Without Cows
85182.synopsis: The award-winning documentary that challenges what we think we know about cows, climate, health, and the future of our planet. Through a global journey spanning 22 countries and five continents, the film explores the complex relationshipbetween food, sustainability, biodiversity, and the people whose lives hang in the balance.

85184.title: 9 to 5
85184.synopsis: In “9 to 5,” a group of female office workers – the all-knowing manager who trained the boss but can't get promoted (Lily Tomlin), a befuddled newcomer (Jane Fonda) and an alluring personal secretary everyone presumes is having an affair (Dolly Parton) – all band together to seek revenge on the man who is making their lives miserable. Directed by Colin Higgins and produced by Bruce Gilbert from a screenplay by Higgins and Patricia Resnick, “9 to 5” received an Academy Award® nomination for the hit title song written and performed by Dolly Parton. Disney will donate net proceeds* from each U.S. ticket purchase to The Dollywood Foundation to support its flagship program, Dolly Parton’s Imagination Library. *Net proceeds refers to the amount received by Disney from the U.S. theatrical ticket sale for the film during the period October 9-15, 2026, less (a) amounts retained by exhibitors, (b) third-party distribution fees and expenses, (c) third-party marketing and advertising expenses incurred in connection with the campaign, and (d) CAF America's administrative fees. Learn more at cafamerica.org and dollywoodfoundation.org. AMC Theatres will also donate a portion of its net proceeds from such ticket sales to The Dollywood Foundation. For AMC, “net proceeds” refers to AMC’s share of ticket sales, less amounts retained by AMC to cover its estimated operational costs.

85185.title: Wild at Heart - Unrated
85185.synopsis:
Guests under 17 must be accompanied by a guardian who is 21 or older. Please be prepared to show ID at the theatre. 
Young lovers Sailor and Lula run from the variety of weirdos that Lula's mom has hired to kill Sailor.

85190.title: Dive in Wonderland
85190.synopsis: Feature length anime inspired by Lewis Carroll's timeless novels. In-crisis university student Rise (Nanoka Hara) tumbles into Wonderland and meets Alice (Maika Pugh) The two have curious adventures in a whimsical, nonsensical world.

85192.title: The Irregular at Magic High School The Movie -Yotsuba Succession Arc-
85192.synopsis: It is  2096, about a century after magic was established as a real technology. Tatsuya Shiba, born into the prestigious Yotsuba family of magicians but with a fatal flaw as a magician, and his perfect younger sister Miyuki, who possesses extraordinary talent as a magician, are about to enter the winter of their second year of high school. The siblings, who are complete opposites as an underachiever and an overachiever, spend their days together in harmony until one day a letter arrives. It is an invitation to the "Keishunkai" to be held at the main Yotsuba house on New Year's Day. At this gathering, where the head of the Yotsuba family, Maya, and the heads of the branch families will come together, the next head of the Yotsuba family will be nominated, but a shocking truth will be revealed there.
85192.cast: Chiwa Saito, Saori Hayami, Yuichi Nakamura

85194.title: Prahaar: The Untold Story of Ujjwal Nikam
85194.synopsis: Inspired by the life of India?s most celebrated public prosecutor, Ujjwal Nikam, the film captures the monumental courtroom battle that followed the 26/11 Mumbai attacks, where one man?s unwavering pursuit of justice led, against all odds, to the conviction of Ajmal Kasab.
85194.cast: Jaideep Ahlawat, Rajkummar Rao, Wamiqa Gabbi

85196.title: Tazza: The Song of Beelzebub
85196.synopsis: In the final Tazza installment, best friends Jang Taeyoung and Park Taeyoung build a massive online casino empire. Driven by jealousy, Park betrays Jang and brings him to rock bottom. Surviving the betrayal, Jang trains under a legendary poker master to sharpen his skills. Years later, the former partners reunite at a high-stakes global poker table backed by the yakuza, where they go head-to-head in an all-or-nothing game of revenge.
85196.cast: Ayaka Miyoshi, Byun Yo-Han, Roh Jae-Won

85197.title: TOMORROW X TOGETHER WORLD TOUR 'ACT : TOMORROW'
85197.synopsis:
In October 2026, an exhilarating moment arrives as HYBE artists and global fans connect as one through the screen. HYBE CINE FEST 2026 expands from Latin America and Asia to screens worldwide.

From the live viewings of BTS's World Tour 'ARIRANG' in Buenos Aires and S?o Paulo, to concert films featuring SEVENTEEN's 'NEW_', TOMORROW X TOGETHER's 'ACT : TOMORROW', and ENHYPEN's 'BLOOD SAGA'--the vivid energy of the artists' world tours will be brought to life right on the screen.

A brilliant light of cheering that will color every corner of the world. Artists, fans, and 'us' transcending borders--gathering as a single light to begin the most radiant and passionate festival.

85201.title: Jump Scare
85201.synopsis: The female metal band Jump Scare retreat to a remote cabin to write their next album, only to be terrorized by the family of cannibals next door

85204.title: This Is Buzz
85204.synopsis: An Experimental, Music-driven Documentary Illustrating The Tale Of The Seismically Influential, Yet Somehow Forgotten, Mtv Slice-of-life Docuseries Buzz, Which Only Ran For 13 Episodes In 1990.

85209.title: 67 Bombs To Enid
85209.synopsis: From executive producer Errol Morris, 67 Bombs to Enid is an intimate, character-driven documentary about survivors of nuclear weapons testing in the Marshall Islands who relocated to rural America, and the generational effects of that testing on the communities it touched.

85210.title: Clean Hands
85210.synopsis: Based on an unbelievable true story, Sergeant Kevin Simmers (Zach Braff) leads a taskforce waging war on drugs in Hagerstown, Maryland, a major stop on the 'Heroin Highway.' At home, he?s a desperate father grappling with his 19-year-old daughter Brooke?s (Esther McGregor) escalating addiction from pain meds to heroin. As Kevin is forced to confront the failures of the system he dedicated his life to defending, together father and daughter fight for recovery, redemption, and hope.
85210.cast: Abigail Spencer, Esther McGregor, Zach Braff

85213.title: Search Party: Where's PawPaw?
85213.synopsis: Noble Kristian Silk Williams rushes home after Aunt Meek Meek (Tichina Arnold) warns that PawPaw's (Tommy Davidson) health has taken a turn for the worse. After visiting him in a rundown nursing home, Noble and her quirky best friends return to find him missing. Joined by their chaotic, self-reformed hood-Aunty, they follow bizarre clues and encounter eccentric characters in a race to find PawPaw before time runs out.
85213.cast: Tichina Arnold, Tommy Davidson, Victoria Monai Richards

85215.title: Paradise Lost
85215.synopsis: From acclaimed master of Korean thriller cinema Yeon Sang-ho comes a gripping psychological mystery. Nine years after her son vanished in a tragic bus kidnapping, grieving mother So-young copes using alternate reality technology. When her missing son suddenly returns as a cold adult stranger, her world fractures between the real, distant man and the virtual child who needs her. So-young is forced into a devastating choice between truth and illusion.

85222.title: World Without Cows Special Q&A w/ Co-Directors Michelle Michaels, Brandon Whitworth & EP Mark Lyons
85222.synopsis: World Without Cows Special Q&A w/ Co-Directors Michelle Michaels, Brandon Whitworth & EP Mark Lyons.

85223.title: #VYMARA
85223.synopsis: Desperate to stay relevant, four washed-up content creators livestream their search for a missing YouTuber linked to a chilling conspiracy video. As they venture deep into the woods in hopes of a fantastical herb, answers and clicks, they uncover something sinister... proving not all content is meant to go viral.

85225.title: C'est quoi l'amour
85225.synopsis: Marguerite and Sofiane are a happily married couple trying to survive the chaos of parenting their teenage daughter Raphaelle. But their daily routine is disrupted when Marguerite?s ex husband Fred shows up with an urgent, and utterly absurd request; they need to get divorced again ?. but this time it?s to annul their Catholic marriage! lnitially dismissive, Marguerite goes along with this yet doesn?t take the process seriously. Alter all, what could possibly go wrong? But her flippant attitude inadvertently sets off a chain reaction of bureaucratie absurdities. Before they know it, Marguerite, Sofiane, their teenage daughter Raphaelle, Cloe, Fred?s new girlfriend, as well as Lea, Marguerite and Fred?s adult daughter, ail embark on a crazy and highly unorthodox trip to the Vatican.
85225.cast: Laure Calamy, Melanie Thierry, Vincent Macaigne

85227.title: Doctor Who: The Satan Pit
85227.synopsis:
Celebrate Doctor Who Day with an exclusive big-screen event marking 20 years of the Tenth Doctor and Rose Tyler.

For the first time ever in cinemas, the acclaimed two-part adventure The Impossible Planet and The Satan Pit have been specially re-edited into a single movie-length presentation, created exclusively for theatrical audiences. Join the Doctor (David Tennant) and Rose (Billie Piper) as they travel to Sanctuary Base 6, a remote outpost perched on a planet orbiting a black hole. When an ancient force awakens beneath the surface, the crew find themselves trapped in a battle against an evil older than time itself.

This special Doctor Who Day screening also includes exclusive bonus material, featuring previously unseen content and a brand-new interview with a special guest, reflecting on the making of one of the most celebrated stories of the modern era -- from encounters with the Ood to facing the terrifying Beast, alongside behind-the-scenes memories from the set.
85227.cast: Billie Piper, Danny Webb, David Tennant

85229.title: Ray Gunn
85229.synopsis: In Metropia, a gigantic city in an alternate future as seen from 1939, private eye Raymond Gunn is drawn into a case involving aliens, murder and a multimedia star named Venus Nova.
85229.cast: Sam Rockwell, Scarlett Johansson, Tom Waits

85230.title: Miss Representation: Rise Up
85230.synopsis: MISS REPRESENTATION: RISE UP dives deep into the cultural backlash against women's mental health, agency, and power with technology exacerbating sexism and misogyny towards women and girls.

85234.title: Buddy The Sing-Along Version
85234.synopsis: A magical, singing orange unicorn holds his cast hostage in a surreal TV-show dimension, as he becomes more and more demented. Now in a SING-ALONG!

85239.title: Closure
85239.synopsis: After his teenage son, Chris, is last seen by a surveillance camera on a bridge over Warsaw's turbulent Vistula River, Daniel embarks on an all-consuming search. Armed with self-built boats, drones, and underwater cameras, he relentlessly scours the river's depths. As months pass, while his own family struggles to live with the uncertainty of Chris's disappearance, Daniel begins helping other families with missing loved ones find answers -- and, at times, the closure that continues to elude him.

85242.title: Tenzing
85242.synopsis: Based on true events, TENZING chronicles the little-known story of Tenzing Norgay (Genden Phuntsok), a gifted Himalayan climber who, alongside New Zealand mountaineer Edmund Hillary (Tom Hiddleston), was the first to summit Mount Everest. Encouraged by his wife Dawa (Thinley Lhamo), Tenzing finds an ally in expedition secretary Jill Henderson (Caitriona Balfe). Together, they persuade Colonel John Hunt (Willem Dafoe) that Tenzing belongs on the British climbing team, rather than merely serving it. Where Western climbers see "Everest" as something to be conquered, Tenzing reveres 'Chomolungma' as the sacred mother goddess. What follows is an ascent defined as much by the tensions between backgrounds, classes and competing ambitions as by the perils of the mountain itself. But high above the world, empire, rank and aspiration fall away, leaving two outsiders bound by mutual respect and trust -- and for Tenzing, the fulfillment of both a lifelong dream and a spiritual calling. Directed by award-winning filmmaker Jennifer Peedom, TENZING is a story of greatness that refuses to be diminished -- and the love that makes it possible.

85244.title: Being Heumann
85244.synopsis: They wouldn't take Judy Heumann's phone calls, so she took their building. In 1977, a young disabled woman (Ruth Madeley) and a scrappy coalition of outsiders decide they've had enough. What begins as one impulsive act becomes the longest occupation of a federal building in American history, as hundreds spontaneously seize government offices and refuse to leave until the bureaucrat in their way (Mark Ruffalo) takes action. Bringing rebellion in all its forms to the hallowed halls, a movement's accidental leaders struggle to find their path forward where none has ever been paved for them. Directed by Academy Award winner Sian Heder (CODA) and based on true events, BEING HEUMANN is the revolutionary, irreverent and deeply human story of the least likely people trying to pull off the impossible and change the lives of millions.
85244.cast: Madeline Delp, Mark Ruffalo, Ruth Madeley

85251.title: Dada
85251.synopsis: A stylish and uncompromising underworld don aggressively conquers the lawless Mumbai streets, weaponizing his fierce trademark justice to systematically dismantle a lethal corporate criminal syndicate.

85252.title: Summer Holidays
85252.synopsis: A city boy's summer at his grandparents' Godavari village transforms when he befriends a spirited local paper boy. Together they explore rural life through adventures that forge an unforgettable childhood bond

announced.title: Making Marie Antoinette
announced.synopsis:
In 2005, Sofia Coppola shot her third feature film, Marie Antoinette, starring Kirsten Dunst and Jason Schwartzman, at the Palace of Versailles, securing unprecedented filming permission that had never before been granted to any production. Her mother, acclaimed documentarian Eleanor Coppola, accompanied her on set, capturing approximately eighty hours of footage chronicling her daughter's journey throughout the making of the film. This year, on the occasion of the 20th anniversary of the release of Marie Antoinette and in fulfilment of her mother's wish, Sofia Coppola edited that previously unseen material. Making Marie Antoinette explores the craftsmanship and care that brought the film to life, follows legendary costume designer Milena Canonero at work, and offers a glimpse into what it meant to be a young female director at that time. The result is a fascinating look at the creative process behind a landmark film and, at the same time, a surprisingly intimate family portrait.

In the documentary, Eleanor Coppola's voice is performed by Academy Award nominee Diane Lane, who reads excerpts from Eleanor's diaries, in which the filmmaker recounts her experience on set and reflects on her relationship with her daughter.

But as victories mount and their dream of glory comes within reach, an unexpected betrayal threatens to tear the team apart. Facing an undefeated reigning champion in the ultimate showdown, they will need more than extraordinary skills -- they must outthink, outplay, and outmanoeuvre their opponents. From visionary filmmaker Stephen Chow, Kung Fu Soccer delivers a crowd-pleasing blend of spectacular football action, martial arts fantasy, comedy, and heart -- an uplifting story about friendship, perseverance, and the pursuit of the impossible.

announced.synopsis: From Executive Producers Barack and Michelle Obama and Oscar-winning documentarian Ben Proudfoot, THE EYES OF GHANA follows 93-year-old filmmaker Chris Hesse, personal cinematographer to Kwame Nkrumah, as he races against blindness and time to rescue more than 1,000 lost films documenting the birth of African independence. Hidden for decades, these incredible images could reshape our understanding of Ghana, Africa, and modern world history.

announced.title: Street Fighter: Sensory Friendly Screening
announced.synopsis: Set in 1993, estranged Street Fighters Ryu and Ken Masters are thrown back into combat when the mysterious Chun-Li recruits them for the next World Warrior Tournament: a brutal clash of fists, fate, and fury. But behind this battle royale lies a deadly conspiracy that forces them to face off against each other and the demons of their past. And if they don't, it's GAME OVER!

announced.title: Closure
announced.synopsis: After his teenage son, Chris, is last seen by a surveillance camera on a bridge over Warsaw's turbulent Vistula River, Daniel embarks on an all-consuming search. Armed with self-built boats, drones, and underwater cameras, he relentlessly scours the river's depths. As months pass, while his own family struggles to live with the uncertainty of Chris's disappearance, Daniel begins helping other families with missing loved ones find answers -- and, at times, the closure that continues to elude him.

announced.title: Hell House LLC 10th Anniversary
announced.synopsis: Five years after an unexplained malfunction causes the death of 15 tour-goers and staff on the opening night of a Halloween haunted house tour, a documentary crew travels back to the scene of the tragedy to find out what really happened.
announced.cast: Alice Bahlke, Danny Bellini, Gore Abrams

announced.title: Fantome de l'Opera, Le
announced.synopsis: Anastasia, 18 years old, full of hopes and dreams, just moved to Paris to become a ballet dancer at the Opera Garnier. The ambitious artistic director, James Figueras, is reviving the Orpheus, the mythic opera by Ernest Dupre, known as The Phantom of the Opera. One night, Anastasia meets the phantom. Together they embark on an impossible love story. Meanwhile the prima ballerina, meant for the role of Euridice, barely escapes death: the curse continues. Soon, Anastasia lands the prestigious role?
announced.cast: Deva Cassel, Romain Duris

announced.title: Christmas at the Kringles
announced.synopsis: The Severson family move to a suburban neighborhood where their neighbors, the Kringles, celebrate Christmas year-round and harbor sinister intentions to hypnotize and indoctrinate them.
announced.cast: Rob Riggle, Ron Livingston

announced.title: Agbara Nla
announced.synopsis: When the village of Muwonleru is trapped under the dark grip of herbalist Isawuru, two believers, Olaboye and Olatomi, leave behind their city lives to carry God's light into the battle. Their mission sparks a fierce clash of faith and power, where obedience and sacrifice unlock deliverance not only for the village, but for Bose and Kola, who must face the darkness within and find restoration.
announced.cast: Damilola Mike-Bamiloye, Mike Bamiloye, Philip Olubakin

announced.title: & Sons
announced.synopsis: A writer tries to reconnect with his sons. Based on the novel by David Gilbert.
announced.cast: Bill Nighy, Dominic West, Imelda Staunton

announced.title: Queen at Sea
announced.synopsis: Amanda and her stepfather Martin struggle with a moral issue that divides them. Has Amanda's mother Leslie, who has dementia, lost the ability to make critical decisions in her own best interests? And, if so, who is responsible -- a spouse, a child, an institution -- for making such a determination? As Amanda and Martin are forced to make increasingly difficult choices, the repercussions spiral out of their control. Academy Award winner Juliette Binoche (The Taste of Things), Academy Award nominee Tom Courtenay (45 Years), Anna Calder-Marshall (Wuthering Heights), and Florence Hunt (Bridgerton) star in this unflinching drama. The film won the Silver Bear Jury Prize and Tom Courtenay and Anna Calder-Marshall won the Silver Bear for Best Supporting Performance at the 2026 Berlin International Film Festival.
announced.cast: Juliette Binoche, Lolabelle Backus, Mohammad Amiri

announced.title: The Mongoose
announced.synopsis: Accused of a crime he didn't commit and with nothing to lose, a war hero (Liam Neeson) leads law enforcement on a cross-country car chase with the help of his brothers in arms and a sympathetic public rooting for his getaway.
announced.cast: Liam Neeson, Marisa Tomei, Ving Rhames

announced.title: The Canvas
announced.synopsis: In an isolated house, a father and his son discover a painting that seems disturbingly alive. When their darkest nightmares begin bleeding into reality, a sinister presence emerges from the canvas, feeding on buried trauma and forgotten memories.
announced.cast: Angus MacFadyen, John Real, Nicolette McKeown

announced.title: The King of Cannabis
announced.synopsis:
Guests under 17 must be accompanied by a guardian who is 21 or older. Please be prepared to show ID at the theatre. Inspired by true events. One man's relentless ambition. An empire that changed America forever.
After his father's sudden job loss shatters his working-class family, he enters the underground cannabis world searching for opportunity. While others see an illegal product, he sees the future of a billion-dollar industry.
Over three decades, he builds one of the most powerful cannabis networks in the country, navigating rival organizations, political corruption, international suppliers, and relentless federal investigations.
Convinced legalization is inevitable, he positions himself years ahead of the market, quietly helping shape the future of cannabis in America. As the walls close in, he embarks on the most dangerous gamble of his life, pushing legalization to the federal level before the government can dismantle everything he built.
Before the government could stop him, he changed the rules of the game. And in doing so, changed America forever.
announced.cast: Alimi Ballard, Charles Malik Whitfield, Luis Guzman

announced.title: Sight & Sound Presents: Joshua Live!
announced.synopsis: Journey alongside the people of Israel as they navigate their newfound freedom in an unforgiving wilderness and under a new leader, Joshua.  Captured in front of a live audience, JOSHUA LIVE! combines the energy of stage performance with the immersive experience of the cinema, bringing this unforgettable story of faith, courage and redemption to movie theaters.
announced.cast: Carl Anderson, Hope Klessig

announced.title: Itllu Arjuna
announced.synopsis: Follows a mute man with exceptional skills who falls in love, proving that true feelings do not always need words.
announced.cast: Aniesh Reddy

announced.title: Imka Em Anukoledhu
announced.cast: Akshay Lagusani, Keyuri

announced.title: Everest: The Other Side
announced.synopsis: An intimate portrait of two people bound by love, ambition, and the pursuit of the impossible. Elite ski mountaineers Jim Morrison and Hilaree Nelson fell deeply in love while reaching the pinnacle of their sport. Their drive sharpened into a shared dream: to climb and ski the direct North Face of Mount Everest - the most difficult and dangerous climb on the mountain and the most coveted ski line on Earth - something only a handful have ever achieved, and no one has successfully skied down.

announced.title: Who Killed Alex Odeh?
announced.synopsis: In October 1985, Santa Ana, California was shaken by a brazen act of political violence when Palestinian American Alex Odeh, a beloved teacher and community leader, was killed by a tripwire bomb planted in his office. Despite substantial evidence and identified suspects, the case was never solved. WHO KILLED ALEX ODEH? reopens the mystery, tracking a renewed investigation in real time as new leads emerge, long-buried records come to light, and the forces behind a political assassination are finally confronted.

announced.title: Paging Hezbollah
announced.synopsis: PAGING HEZBOLLAH reveals how Israel pulled off one of the most audacious intelligence operations in history - engineering, marketing, and smuggling a modern-day Trojan Horse into Hezbollah's command network before destroying it with a single beep. Told by those who lived and planned it, this is the little-known story of ingenuity, deception and an operation decades in the making.
announced.cast: Benjamin Netanyahu, David Petraeus

announced.title: Jump Scare
announced.synopsis: The female metal band Jump Scare retreat to a remote cabin to write their next album, only to be terrorized by the family of cannibals next door
announced.cast: Erin Ruth Walker, Shannon Dang

announced.title: Iles de Guadeloupe - Les aventuriers voyageurs
announced.synopsis: Seeking freedom after years spent at the intense pace of the morning show Salut Bonjour, Gino Chouinard offers himself a complete immersion in the heart of the Guadeloupe Islands, a destination where lush nature, the sweetness of life and the Creole soul intertwine with strength.

announced.title: The Irregular at Magic High School The Movie -Yotsuba Succession Arc-
announced.synopsis: It is  2096, about a century after magic was established as a real technology. Tatsuya Shiba, born into the prestigious Yotsuba family of magicians but with a fatal flaw as a magician, and his perfect younger sister Miyuki, who possesses extraordinary talent as a magician, are about to enter the winter of their second year of high school. The siblings, who are complete opposites as an underachiever and an overachiever, spend their days together in harmony until one day a letter arrives. It is an invitation to the "Keishunkai" to be held at the main Yotsuba house on New Year's Day. At this gathering, where the head of the Yotsuba family, Maya, and the heads of the branch families will come together, the next head of the Yotsuba family will be nominated, but a shocking truth will be revealed there.
announced.cast: Chiwa Saito, Saori Hayami, Yuichi Nakamura

announced.title: AMC Screen Unseen: November 2
announced.synopsis: AMC Screen Unseen, where guests can watch a never-before-seen film. We will share the movie’s MPA rating ahead of time, but the feature presentation will remain a mystery until showtime. Share your reaction after the movie with #AMCScreenUnseen on Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Threads and X.

announced.title: 67 Bombs To Enid
announced.synopsis: From executive producer Errol Morris, 67 Bombs to Enid is an intimate, character-driven documentary about survivors of nuclear weapons testing in the Marshall Islands who relocated to rural America, and the generational effects of that testing on the communities it touched.

announced.title: NT Live: Golden Boy
announced.cast: Daniel Mays, Hayley Squires, Josh O'Connor

announced.title: Ramayana
announced.synopsis: RAMAYANA is based on an ancient Epic still celebrated by billions across the globe. RAMA, a prince bound by duty and sacrifice, must confront RAVANA, an immortal ruler driven by pride and vengeance. Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, with music and score by Hans Zimmer and A.R. Rahman.
announced.cast: Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, Yash

announced.title: The One
announced.synopsis: When 18-year-old Hawk ages out of the Chicago foster system, he sets out to see the lighting of the country's largest Christmas tree, the One. Carrying only his guitar and a few belongings, he faces homelessness and a harsh winter alone until he crosses paths with Jefferson, a mysterious traveler, and Alexis, a runaway teenager grieving the loss of her twin sister. Together, they embark on an unexpected journey of faith, hope, and healing.
announced.cast: Jana Kramer, Martin Sheen, Nick Zano

announced.title: Summer Holidays
announced.synopsis: A city boy's summer at his grandparents' Godavari village transforms when he befriends a spirited local paper boy. Together they explore rural life through adventures that forge an unforgettable childhood bond
announced.cast: Arun, Khushi, Rohan

announced.title: The Cat in the Hat
announced.synopsis: Meet the Cat in the Hat you don't know! In the wonderfully whimsical tradition of Dr. Seuss, THE CAT IN THE HAT, voiced by Bill Hader, comes to the big screen in his animated theatrical feature film debut, an all-new, epic adventure where mischief, magic and mayhem reign supreme.
announced.cast: Bill Hader, Paula Pell, Quinta Brunson, Xochitl Gomez

announced.title: Mouse
announced.synopsis: When an introverted high-schooler in small-town Arkansas loses her best friend to a car accident, she forms an unexpected bond with her friend's mother while navigating the fraught, fragile, and often funny stages of grief.
announced.cast: Chloe Coleman, Katherine Mallen Kupferer, Sophie Okonedo

announced.title: Club Kid
announced.synopsis: An organizer of underground parties is forced to take care of a son whose existence he was completely unaware of.
announced.cast: Cara Delevingne, Diego Calva, Miss Benny

announced.title: Wild Horse Nine
announced.synopsis: In 1973 Chile, CIA agents Chris and Lee face a trust-testing journey from Santiago to Easter Island.
announced.cast: John Malkovich, Sam Rockwell

announced.title: Paradise Lost
announced.synopsis: From acclaimed master of Korean thriller cinema Yeon Sang-ho comes a gripping psychological mystery. Nine years after her son vanished in a tragic bus kidnapping, grieving mother So-young copes using alternate reality technology. When her missing son suddenly returns as a cold adult stranger, her world fractures between the real, distant man and the virtual child who needs her. So-young is forced into a devastating choice between truth and illusion.
announced.cast: Kim Hyun-Joo

announced.title: Raise the Red Lantern (1991) (re)
announced.synopsis: Teenage Songlian (Gong Li), whose family has been devastated by the recent death of her father, becomes the third concubine of wealthy Master Chen. She soon discovers that behind the palatial luxury of life in the master's house, she and her fellow concubines are pitted against each other in a struggle for his affections. The situation inevitably leads to deception, jealous rages, and the revelation of each other's darkest secrets.
announced.cast: Caifei He, Li Gong

announced.title: Being Heumann
announced.synopsis: They wouldn't take Judy Heumann's phone calls, so she took their building. In 1977, a young disabled woman (Ruth Madeley) and a scrappy coalition of outsiders decide they've had enough. What begins as one impulsive act becomes the longest occupation of a federal building in American history, as hundreds spontaneously seize government offices and refuse to leave until the bureaucrat in their way (Mark Ruffalo) takes action. Bringing rebellion in all its forms to the hallowed halls, a movement's accidental leaders struggle to find their path forward where none has ever been paved for them. Directed by Academy Award winner Sian Heder (CODA) and based on true events, BEING HEUMANN is the revolutionary, irreverent and deeply human story of the least likely people trying to pull off the impossible and change the lives of millions.
announced.cast: Madeline Delp, Mark Ruffalo, Ruth Madeley

announced.title: I Play Rocky
announced.synopsis: The film is an electrifying true story about an unknown actor with an unshakable belief that he wasn't just meant to write Rocky--he was meant to be Rocky Balboa. Told "no" at every turn, Sylvester Stallone bets everything on himself, holding the line on playing the lead against seemingly impossible odds. The result is the ultimate underdog story behind the ultimate underdog movie.
announced.cast: Annasophia Robb, Anthony Ippolito, Matt Dillon

announced.title: Ghost Soldier
announced.synopsis: In the action-thriller GHOST SOLDIER, Jim Caviezel stars as Henry "Fitz" Fitzgerald, a solitary man with a mysterious past, living a quiet life off the grid in his hometown. But when a powerful foreign corporation descends on his community determined to seize his and his neighbors' land for a massive payday, Fitz takes action -- he's actually a former Special Forces soldier and advanced weapons developer. Armed with weapons no one has ever seen, a lifetime of lethal military training, and an unwavering code of justice, Fitz becomes the one thing his enemies never anticipated: a one-man war they can't win.
announced.cast: Beau Knapp, Jim Caviezel, Olivia Thirlby

announced.title: Villeneuve: L'ascension d'une legende
announced.cast: Joe Cobden, Luc Picard, Neil Webb

announced.title: Soul Patrol
announced.synopsis: Soul Patrol uncovers a hidden chapter of American military history by focusing on the Vietnam War's first Black special ops team, an elite unit operating deep behind enemy lines. With unprecedented access to this once-secretive group of African-American veterans, director J.M. Harper reconstructs their journey with an immediacy rarely seen in Vietnam War storytelling, using raw Super 8 footage, photographs, and audio recordings from their personal archives. Opening on the war?s 50th anniversary, the surviving members reunite in a hotel that becomes a surreal liminal space, where memory, brotherhood, and unresolved trauma collide. As the men reflect on their experiences, the film interrogates the contradictions of fighting for freedom abroad while facing inequality at home. Winner of the Directing Award for U.S. Documentary at the Sundance Film Festival, Soul Patrol is not just a war story, but a reckoning ? an intimate portrait of survival, memory, and the enduring cost of war on those asked to fight it.

announced.title: Dead of Night
announced.synopsis: When a small town is terrorized by a series of brutal murders, the sheriff, his daughter, and a desperate mayor race to uncover the truth.
announced.cast: Dermot Mulroney, Kirrilee Berger, Scott Grimes

announced.title: Search Party: Where's PawPaw?
announced.synopsis: Noble Kristian Silk Williams rushes home after Aunt Meek Meek (Tichina Arnold) warns that PawPaw's (Tommy Davidson) health has taken a turn for the worse. After visiting him in a rundown nursing home, Noble and her quirky best friends return to find him missing. Joined by their chaotic, self-reformed hood-Aunty, they follow bizarre clues and encounter eccentric characters in a race to find PawPaw before time runs out.
announced.cast: Tichina Arnold, Tommy Davidson, Victoria Monai Richards

announced.title: Paper Tiger
announced.synopsis: Two brothers pursue the American Dream but get entangled in a dangerous Russian mafia scheme that terrorizes their family, testing their bond as betrayal becomes possible.
announced.cast: Adam Driver, Scarlett Johansson

announced.title: How to Rob a Bank
announced.synopsis: In HOW TO ROB A BANK, a crew of social media-savvy bank robbers broadcasts their daring heists, unaware that their growing viral fame has put them in the crosshairs of a veteran FBI agent and a brilliant software engineer. Despite the unlikely duo closing in, the crime ring pushes past their limits, putting everything on the line for their most ambitious heist yet.
announced.cast: Anna Sawai, Nicholas Hoult, Pete Davidson

announced.title: Ebenezer
announced.synopsis: This November, Johnny Depp is Ebenezer Scrooge. The name you know, the story you don?t. From Ti West, EBENEZER also stars Rupert Grint, Andrea Riseborough, Sam Claflin, Daisy Ridley, Arthur Conti, Ellie Bamber, Henry Lloyd-Hughes, Charlie Murphy, with Tramell Tillman and Ian McKellen.
announced.cast: Johnny Depp, Rupert Grint

announced.title: The Angry Birds Movie: 10th Anniversary
announced.synopsis: Celebrate the 10th anniversary of The Angry Birds Movie with a limited three-night theatrical event this November. A proven family hit filled with action, humor, and fan-favorite characters, this special engagement brings audiences back to Bird Island for a big-screen experience the whole family will enjoy.
announced.cast: Bill Hader, Danny McBride, Jason Sudeikis, Josh Gad

announced.title: In the Mouth
announced.synopsis: A perpetual worrywart finds himself unable to leave his house after discovering a giant version of himself protruding from his front lawn.
announced.cast: Colin Burgess, Paul Rothery, Sage Francis

announced.title: Bitter Christmas
announced.synopsis: BITTER CHRISTMAS tells two alternating stories, one starring Elsa, an advertising director, in 2004, during a long weekend in December. The second takes place in 2026 and stars Raul, a screenwriter and director who is writing a script that we soon discover is the story of Elsa, her boyfriend Bonifacio, and her friends Patricia and Natalia. Mixed with fiction, Elsa is, in a way, Raul's alter ego, who, like him, resorts to autofiction as a solution to a long period of creative drought. He looks inside himself, and he can't help but also look at the people who make up his most intimate universe: his partner and his assistant.
announced.cast: Aitana Sanchez-Gijon, Barbara Lennie, Leonardo Sbaraglia, Victoria Luengo

announced.title: Victorian Psycho
announced.synopsis: Set in Victorian England, Victorian Psycho sees an eccentric governess arrive at a remote gothic manor, where strange happenings stir suspicion that she?s not what she seems.
announced.cast: Jason Isaacs, Maika Monroe, Thomasin McKenzie

announced.title: Autre, L'
announced.synopsis: A cancer surgery patient faces both imagined threats and real perils during recovery.
announced.cast: Bilel Chegrani, Maxime Genois, Pierre-Yves Cardinal

announced.title: League of Legends Worlds 26 / Finals in Cinema
announced.synopsis: The League of Legends World Championship Finals are back on the big screen! In this 2026 edition, 19 teams from around the world will compete for the title of World Champion, with the grand final broadcast live in theatres.

announced.title: Orfeo
announced.synopsis: In the classic Greek tragedy, a snake bites Eurydice on her wedding day, and her new husband, Orpheus, travels to the Underworld to bring her back. Virgilio Villoresi's expressionistic adaptation of the tale is based on Dino Buzzati's 1969 Poema a fumetti, Italy's first graphic novel. The film is a modern reimagining with an aesthetic untethered from reality: a kaleidoscopic journey through time and place, reflecting on art, love, mystery, eroticism, melancholy, life, and death.
announced.cast: Aomi Muyock, Giulia Maenza, Luca Vergoni

announced.title: ENE Repeat
announced.synopsis: ENE REPEAT reunites a close-knit group of friends as they embark on another unforgettable journey, where old memories, new adventures, and unexpected twists test their friendship.
announced.cast: Abhinav Gomatam, Maganti Srinath, Vishwak Sen

announced.title: Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping
announced.synopsis: THE HUNGER GAMES: SUNRISE ON THE REAPING will revisit the world of Panem 24 years before the events of The Hunger Games, starting on the morning of the reaping of the 50th Hunger Games, also known as the Second Quarter Quell.
announced.cast: Jesse Plemons, Joseph Zada, Ralph Fiennes

announced.title: Elsinore
announced.synopsis: The deeply emotional and inspirational true story of Ian Charleson, a gifted actor whose greatest challenge becomes his greatest triumph. Facing his own mortality with unflinching honesty, wit, and grace, Charleson delivers a courageous performance that becomes a source of healing and inspiration for those around him.
announced.cast: Andrew Scott, Billie Piper, Olivia Colman

announced.title: November 1963
announced.synopsis: The story of the Killing of a President as told by Joseph Giancana, who was with his brother, Sam Giancana during those days. Written by their nephew and told in real time about the underbelly that pulled off this crime.
announced.cast: Dermot Mulroney, John Travolta, Robert Carlyle

announced.title: Carl Jackson's LAX: Holiday in New York
announced.synopsis: The third and final installment of the trilogy is LAX: Holiday in New York, directed by Carl Jackson. Set against the glittering, holiday-lit backdrop of New York City, the film centers on John and Kelly. The couple is in the middle of a divorce but decides to come together to spend one final Christmas holiday as a family. However, old secrets quickly resurface and hidden tensions ignite, making them realize that reuniting for the holidays may have been their most dangerous mistake yet.
announced.cast: Andrea McClew

announced.title: Best Pancakes in the County
announced.synopsis: A cunning criminal returns to his remote diner after a botched FBI heist, where rival assassins, corrupt agents, and an underestimated waitress collide in a deadly confrontation.

announced.title: Josephine
announced.synopsis: After 8-year-old Josephine accidentally witnesses a crime in Golden Gate Park, she acts out in search of a way to regain control of her safety, while adults are helpless to console her.
announced.cast: Channing Tatum, Gemma Chan, Mason Reeves, Philip Ettinger

announced.title: Minotaur
announced.synopsis: Intrigue, corruption, betrayal, survival: the walls of the maze are closing in. The latest from Academy Award nominated writer-director Andrey Zvyagintsev (Loveless, Leviathan), Cannes Grand Prix winner MINOTAUR is a twist-laden parable for our times. Russia, 2022. Amidst the comfortable trappings of affluence and domesticity, corporate executive Gleb (Dmitriy Mazurov) finds himself under siege on all fronts. At home, he is haunted by suspicions that his increasingly distant wife Galina (Iris Lebedeva) is unfaithful. At work, he contends with a demand from local authorities to draft a quota of employees for the war in Ukraine. Desperate to keep his hands clean, Gleb struggles to reassert control even as the collapse of his carefully ordered life seems fated to accelerate toward violence. A pressure cooker in cinematic form, MINOTAUR uncovers and indicts the heart of societal darkness with searing clarity. Uniting intimately-drawn performances and stark visual power, this is peerless work from an indisputable master.
announced.cast: Dmitriy Mazurov, Iris Lebedeva

announced.title: The Host (2007) (re)
announced.synopsis: Gang-du (SONG Kang-ho) works at a food-stand on the banks of the Han River. Dozing on the job, he is awakened by his daughter, Hyun-seo ( KO A-sung), who is angry with him for missing a teacher-parent meeting at school. As Gang-du walks out to the riverbank with a delivery, he notices that a large crowd of people has gathered, taking pictures and talking about something hanging from the Han River Bridge. The otherwise idyllic landscape turns suddenly to bedlam when a terrifying creature climbs up onto the riverbank and begins to crush and eat people. Gang-du and his daughter run for their lives but suddenly the thing grabs Hyun-seo and disappears back into the river. The government announces that the thing apparently is the Host of an unidentified virus. Having feared the worst, Gang-du receives a phone call from his daughter who is frightened, but very much alive. Gang-du makes plans to infiltrate the forbidden zone near the Han River to rescue his daughter from the clutches of the horrifying Host...
announced.cast: Hie-Bong Byeon, Kang-Ho Song

announced.title: Danemark et les Iles Feroe - Les aventuriers voyageurs
announced.synopsis: In this documentary, at once a journey of discovery, an intimate exploration, and a reflection on quality of life, Tommy and his travel companion  Janie Lapointe  explore this realm shaped by water, wind, and a profoundly human philosophy of living. Here, urbanism meets nature, design meets tradition, and happiness is cultivated day after day.

announced.title: Disney's Hexed
announced.synopsis: In Hexed, an impulsive and unconventional teenage girl named Billie (voice of Hailee Steinfeld) discovers secret magical abilities which, once unleashed, hurtle her into a spectacle-filled journey out of suburbia and into a vast witch realm called Hexe. Forced to team up with her cautious mother, Alice (voice of Rashida Jones), they uncover family mysteries that could change the world of witches forever. Directed by Fawn Veerasunthorn and Jason Hand, co-directed by Josie Trinidad, and produced by Roy Conli and Yvett Merino.
announced.cast: Hailee Steinfeld, Rashida Jones
announced.directors: Fawn Veerasunthorn, Jason Hand, Josie Trinidad

announced.title: The FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH
announced.synopsis: Murder, blackmail, theft, extortion — just another summer in Hollywood. It’s 1977, eight years since Cliff Booth (Brad Pitt) encountered the Manson family in Quentin Tarantino’s parallel history of 1969, Once Upon a Time… in Hollywood. In THE FURTHER MIS-ADVENTURES OF CLIFF BOOTH, directed by David Fincher from a new script by Tarantino, the fairytale is over. Los Angeles no longer needs a hippie-slaying stuntman the way it did. But Hollywood will always have problems, problems that can only be solved by someone with Cliff’s unique (occasionally extralegal) abilities. When he’s not earning his keep bartending or as a projectionist, Cliff Booth is a fixer — solving situations for Hollywood’s great and, sometimes, not so good. He’s curious when he gets a call from talent agent Karen Crosby (Elizabeth Debicki), on behalf of her client, TV megastar Charlie Peters (Scott Caan) — a man known for doing his own stunts. And he’s further entertained and intrigued when he meets other characters in Charlie’s world, from his knowing wife Toni (Carla Gugino) to pro football champion turned screen star Roderick “Hot Rod” Harrison (Yahya Abdul-Mateen II). Then there are the Verdusco brothers (Matt Groove and JB Tadena), mysterious gangsters causing mayhem across the city. What was once a fairytale is now a crime story — a cocktail of violence, ambition, and desire that could only happen in LA. Discover whether the further adventures — or mis-adventures — of Cliff Booth end happily ever after on November 25 in IMAX at AMC.
announced.cast: Brad Pitt, Elizabeth Debicki, Scott Caan

announced.title: All of a Sudden
announced.synopsis: Two scholars exchange letters about chance and risk. As the philosopher falls ill, their academic correspondence evolves into intimate discussions about mortality and a deeper connection forms between them.
announced.cast: Tao Okamoto, Virginie Efira

announced.title: Focker-In-Law
announced.synopsis: A young man named Henry, son of Greg and Pam Focker, faces family chaos when he decides to marry a strong-willed woman who appears to be his complete mismatch.
announced.cast: Ben Stiller, Robert De Niro, Teri Polo

announced.title: Yeh Prem Mol Liya
announced.cast: Ayushmann Khurrana, Sharvari Wagh

announced.title: The Polar Express
announced.synopsis: On Christmas Eve, a young boy embarks on a magical adventure to the North Pole on the Polar Express, while learning about friendship, bravery, and the spirit of Christmas.

announced.title: Flavia Girl Detective
announced.synopsis: Amateur detective. Master poisoner. Eleven years old. When Flavia finds a dead body at her family's decaying British manor house and her father is accused of murder, she dives into her own wild and fearless investigation, unearthing long-held family secrets and pitting herself against the true murderer. A little genius goes a long way. Based on the internationally renowned and New York Times bestselling The Flavia de Luce mystery book series.
announced.cast: Jonathan Pryce, Martin Freeman, Molly Belle Wright

announced.title: Love Actually (HFS26)
announced.synopsis: Follows the lives of eight very different couples in dealing with their love lives in various loosely interrelated tales all set during a frantic month before Christmas in London, England.

announced.title: Dr. Seuss' How The Grinch Stole Christmas
announced.synopsis: The curmudgeonly recluse Grinch, who hates Christmas, becomes annoyed with the out-of-control Christmas festivities in Whoville, the town lying below his cave dwelling on Mt. Crumpit. But after the Grinch conspires to deprive the Who's of their favorite holiday by sneaking into town on Christmas eve to steal everything associated with the holiday, he learns that the spirit of Christmas goes much deeper than tinsel and toys.

announced.title: Bad Santa
announced.synopsis: Two con men masquerade as Santa Claus and an elf, knocking off shopping malls. But then they meet an 8-year-old boy, who unintentionally reminds them about the true meaning of Christmas.

announced.title: Above the Below
announced.synopsis: In this tense thriller, three astronauts (Idris Elba, Caitlin FitzGerald, and Hero Fiennes Tiffin) return to Earth only to discover their fight for survival has just begun. Directed by Idris Elba and Martin Owen, the film follows the crew after their damaged spacecraft is violently hurled through the atmosphere and plunges into the depths of the ocean. With oxygen rapidly running out and hope fading, they are forced to make an unthinkable choice: who will risk everything to reach the surface...and who will remain behind with the wreckage below.
announced.cast: Idris Elba

announced.title: Behemoth!
announced.synopsis: A gifted cellist, Alex Serian (Pedro Pascal), returns home to Los Angeles after 20 years on the road.  Music, which has been the constant, all-consuming river of his life, begins to carry Alex on an adventure that will change him forever.
announced.cast: Eva Victor, Olivia Wilde, Pedro Pascal

announced.title: Ray Gunn
announced.synopsis: In Metropia, a gigantic city in an alternate future as seen from 1939, private eye Raymond Gunn is drawn into a case involving aliens, murder and a multimedia star named Venus Nova.
announced.cast: Sam Rockwell, Scarlett Johansson, Tom Waits

announced.title: Elf
announced.synopsis: A human baby raised as an elf. A city where no one remembers the true meaning of Christmas. Will Ferrell (Saturday Night Live, Superstar) stars as Buddy, a human raised in the North Pole to be an elf. After wreaking havoc in the elf community due to his size, Buddy heads to New York City to find his place in the world, and track down his father. But life in the big city is not all sugarplums and candy canes. His father is a 'Scrooge' and his eight-year-old stepbrother doesn't believe in Santa. Even the snowmen aren't friendly in New York. In fact, they don't even speak. Worst of all, everyone has forgotten the true meaning of Christmas, and it's up to Buddy and his simple elf ways to win over his family, realize his destiny and, ultimately, save Christmas for New York and the world. Directed by John Favreau (Swingers), Elf is a warm-hearted Christmas comedy written by David Berenbaum.

announced.title: The Gallerist
announced.synopsis: A gallerist, driven by a desperate desire for success, hatches a scheme to cover up a dead man as an extraordinary art piece at a pretentious Miami art fair.
announced.cast: Jenna Ortega, Natalie Portman, Sterling K. Brown

announced.title: Tender Loving Care
announced.synopsis: Palme d'Or winner and Academy Award nominee Mike Leigh returns with his next feature film, continuing his insightful exploration of the contemporary world. With his distinctive cinematic voice, he once again delves into themes that challenge and resonate with modern audiences.
announced.cast: Kate O'Flynn, Marion Bailey, Paul Jesson

announced.title: Everybody Digs Bill Evans
announced.synopsis: June 1961, New York. Legendary jazz pianist Bill Evans has found his musical voice and created the perfect trio, including bass player Scott LaFaro, his musical soulmate. A residency at New York's Village Vanguard culminates in the live taping of two of the greatest jazz records of all time in one day. Days later, LaFaro dies tragically in a car crash. Numb with grief, Evans stops playing for the first time since childhood. This is the story of what happened next for one of the most influential and gifted figures in 20th Century music. Grant Gee won Best Director at the 2026 Berlin International Film Festival.
announced.cast: Anders Danielsen Lie, Bill Pullman, Laurie Metcalf

announced.title: Gremlins
announced.synopsis: With its Christmas lights and dusting of snow, Kingston Falls is an idyllic small town--until the gremlins take over. A father returns from Chinatown with an unusual pet, a Mogwai--a gift for his son. The rules are simple: Keep your Mogwai away from water, bright lights and, most importantly, never--never--feed him after midnight. But the rules are inadvertently broken, and the consequences multiply at an alarming rate.

announced.title: Scrooged
announced.synopsis: High-spirited high jinks on Christmas Eve put Frank Cross (Bill Murray) in a ghostly time warp in this hilarious take-off of Charles Dickens' A Christmas Carol. Cross, who has made the meteoric rise from the depths of the mail room to TV network president, is mean, nasty, uncaring, unforgiving and has a sadistic sense of humor - perfect qualities for a modern-day Scrooge. Before the night is over, he'll be visited by a maniacal New York cab driver from the past, a present-day fairy who’s into pratfalls and, finally, a ghoulish, seven-foot headless messenger from the future.

announced.title: The Friend's House is Here
announced.cast: Hana Mana, Mahshad Bahraminejad

announced.title: Violent Night 2
announced.synopsis:
If you're nice, you get presents from the Big Guy. If you're naughty, you get justice.

David Harbour reprises his role as Santa Claus in a propulsive new chapter in yuletide mayhem from 87North--the powerhouse producers of Bullet Train, John Wick, The Fall Guy, Atomic Blonde and the Nobody franchise--and returning action director Tommy Wirkola.

In 2022's bare-knuckle holiday sensation, VIOLENT NIGHT, an embittered Santa, armed with lethal combat skills, took out a team of mercenaries to rescue a girl and her family. Now, not-so-jolly Saint Nick suits up again to take on a ruthless gangster (Emmy and Golden Globe nominee Jared Harris) terrorizing the merchants of the Silver Bell Mall.

But when Santa forgets the true meaning of Christmas, he finds himself in the heart of a lively mall community in desperate need of his help. Sapped of his magic, he'll need another way to take on the goons threatening the mall, and time is running out. Santa has to rediscover his faith in goodness and call in some last-minute reinforcements from the one person no baddie wants to tangle with: Mrs. Claus (Emmy and Golden Globe nominee Kristen Bell). 

Along with David Harbour, Jared Harris and Kristen Bell, the dynamic cast includes Emmy winning screen legend Joe Pantoliano (The Last of Us, The Sopranos), Daniela Melchior (Fast X, Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3), Andrew Bachelor (Greenland, The Walking Dead), and AEW professional wrestler Maxwell Friedman (The Iron Claw, Happy Gilmore 2).

VIOLENT NIGHT 2 is directed by returning filmmaker Tommy Wirkola and produced again by 87North founders Kelly McCormick and David Leitch. The film's returning screenwriters are Pat Casey and Josh Miller. Violent Night 2 will be released by Universal Pictures.
announced.cast: David Harbour, Jared Harris, Kristen Bell

announced.title: Andre Rieu's 2026 Christmas Concert: Let it Snow!
announced.synopsis: Known to millions as `The King of Waltz?, Andre Rieu is the world?s leading pop classical artist and consistently appears on the worldwide list of highest-grossing touring artists.

announced.title: Rose
announced.synopsis: In the turmoil of the Thirty-Years' War, a mysterious soldier appears in a secluded Protestant village claiming to be heir to a long-abandoned manor. His quest for recognition and acceptance are complicated by his secret: under a false identity, false name, and pretense of a false gender, he has made his way to the village. But to achieve her goals, Rose, as the soldier is actually called, will stop at nothing.
announced.cast: Caro Braun, Sandra Huller

announced.title: Clarissa
announced.synopsis: Based on Mrs. Dalloway. Follows a Lagos society wife preparing for a party while reflecting on her youth and the choices that led her to marry a respected man instead of her poet boyfriend.
announced.cast: Ayo Edebiri, David Oyelowo, Sophie Okonedo

announced.title: Ink
announced.synopsis: The film is based on the Tony-nominated play by multi-Olivier award-winning playwright and screenwriter James Graham. The film is an explosive cinematic rollercoaster about a group of visionaries and misfits who had an idea for a new kind of news -- one that would give the people what they want and would change the face of the world we live in today.
announced.cast: Claire Foy, Guy Pearce, Jack O'Connell

announced.title: Secret Lives of Baba Segi's Wives

announced.cast: Bimbo Ademoye, Mercy Aigbe, Odunlade Adekola

announced.title: ZERO A.D.: The Birth of Christ
announced.synopsis: A brutal ruler fears a prophecy and orders the death of a child - one who will change history.
announced.cast: Ben Mendelsohn, Deva Cassel, Gael Garcia Bernal, Sam Worthington

announced.title: George Michael: The Faith Tour
announced.synopsis: An electric concert film featuring recently rediscovered, never-before-seen footage of the global superstar at the Palais Omnisports de Paris-Bercy during the European leg of the Faith Tour in 1988. A triumph in archival filmmaking, George Michael: The Faith Tour transforms footage assembled from a 14-camera shoot captured on 35mm film over two nights, into an extraordinary cinematic event and audio experience.

announced.title: The Debut
announced.synopsis: When Mona Friedman is cast in a bit part at a small community theater, she transforms from a shy, unassuming housewife into a zealous method actor willing to do anything to protect the artistic integrity of her marginal role--even if it means waging war against the show's domineering director.
announced.cast: Halle Bailey, Julianne Moore, Paul Giamatti

announced.title: Gradiva, La
announced.synopsis: A class of high school students travels to Pompeii to discover ruins and bodies petrified by Vesuvius. The trip becomes a rare moment when the force of youth meets a world frozen in time. Their desires start to surface with unexpected intensity, leading them toward an irreversible fracture.
announced.cast: Colas Quignard, Suzanne Gerin

announced.cast: Jason Sudeikis, Josh Gad

announced.cast: Shah Rukh Khan

announced.cast: David Corenswet, Michael Shannon

announced.title: Werwulf
announced.synopsis: Witness Robert Eggers’ most visceral and haunting experience yet. Focus Features presents WERWULF, a harrowing tale of devotion, damnation and the devil within.

announced.title: Artificial
announced.cast: Andrew Garfield, Monica Barbaro, Yura Borisov

announced.title: Look Back
announced.synopsis:
Confident grade-schooler Fujino draws comics for her school newspaper, earning the admiration of her classmates. When her artwork is surpassed by her reclusive peer Kyomoto, she becomes obsessed with honing her skills, eventually burning out and giving up drawing altogether. But when Fujino finally meets Kyomoto, she discovers that Kyomoto has been her devoted fan all along. Bound by their shared passion, they spend irreplaceable years drawing manga together until a fateful event changes their lives forever.

From Palme d'Or winner Hirokazu Koreeda, Look Back is a love letter to the artistic process, hand-written in ink on paper, and a meditation on how mutual pursuit of a craft creates the deepest etches in our memory.
announced.cast: Miyu Sasaki, Ryo Ikeda

announced.title: Pendulum
announced.synopsis: Married couple Patrick (Gordon-Levitt) and Abigail (Dynevor) travel to a secluded New Mexico retreat seeking healing after a traumatic event. But as Abigail falls deeper under the influence of the retreat's enigmatic leader (Weaver), Patrick begins to suspect something far more sinister lurks beneath the group's spiritual promises. As paranoia spirals into terror, the couple uncovers a horrifying truth that may consume them both before they can escape.
announced.cast: Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Norman Reedus, Phoebe Dynevor
